sentences.zh: 推天正中氣以策實乘入元距所求積算，命曰中積分。

translations.literal: To seek the heavenly central qi, multiply the accumulated count from the era entry to the year sought by stalk substance; call it central accumulated parts.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the celestial central qi, multiply the era count from the high origin to the year sought by the year-fraction constant; this yields the central accumulated parts.

sentences.zh: 盈大衍通法得一，為積日。

translations.literal: When full of the Great Extension universal method, obtain one; this is accumulated days.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the Dayan universal divisor; the quotient is accumulated days.

sentences.zh: 不盈者，為小餘。

translations.literal: What does not fill becomes the minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 爻數去積日，不盡日為大餘。

translations.literal: Remove accumulated days by line number; days not exhausted become the major remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full cycles of sixty from the accumulated days; the days left are the major remainder.

sentences.zh: 數從甲子起算外，即所求年天正中氣冬至日及小餘也。

translations.literal: Count outward from jiazi; that is the winter solstice day of the heavenly central qi for the year sought and its minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from jiazi; the result is the winter solstice day of the celestial central qi for the year sought, with its minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 求次氣因天正中氣大小餘，以三元之策及餘秒加之。

translations.literal: To seek the next qi, take the major and minor remainders of the heavenly central qi and add the three-origin stalks with remainder and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next qi, add the three-origin interval and its remainder and parts to the major and minor remainders of the celestial central qi.

sentences.zh: 其秒盈象統，從小餘。

translations.literal: When parts fill the image cycle, carry to the minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the fractional parts fill the image cycle, carry into the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 小餘滿大衍通法，從大餘。

translations.literal: When the minor remainder fills the Great Extension universal method, carry to the major remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When the minor remainder fills the Dayan universal divisor, carry into the major remainder.

sentences.zh: 大餘滿爻數，去之。

translations.literal: When the major remainder fills the line number, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the major remainder fills sixty, cast it out.

sentences.zh: 命如前，即次氣恆日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Fix the era as before; that is the constant day of the next qi and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: Fix the era as before; the result is the constant day of the next qi with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 凡率相因加者，下有餘秒，皆以類相從。

translations.literal: Whenever linked rates are added and below there are remainder parts, all follow their kind together.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever linked rates are added and fractional remainders remain below, combine them by kind.

sentences.zh: 而滿其法，則迭進之，用加上位。

translations.literal: When full of its method, advance stepwise and add to the upper position.
translations.idiomatic: When a divisor is filled, carry upward step by step and add to the higher place.

sentences.zh: 日盈爻數，去之也。

translations.literal: When days overflow the line number, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full cycles of sixty when days overflow.

sentences.zh: 推天正合朔以揲法去中積分。

translations.literal: To seek the heavenly-standard conjunction, remove central accumulated parts by the sorting method.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the winter new moon, divide the central accumulated parts by the new-moon constant.

sentences.zh: 其所不盡，曰歸餘之卦。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is called the hexagram of returned remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the intercalation pendulum.

sentences.zh: 以減積積分，餘為朔積分。

translations.literal: Subtract from the accumulated parts; the remainder is new-moon accumulated parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract that amount from the accumulated parts; the remainder is the new-moon accumulated parts.

sentences.zh: 乃如大衍通法而一，為日。

translations.literal: Then take one per Great Extension universal method; this is days.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the Dayan universal divisor; the quotient is days.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為小餘。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is the minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 日盈爻數，去之。

translations.literal: When days overflow the line number, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full cycles of sixty when days overflow.

sentences.zh: 不盈者，為大餘。

translations.literal: What does not fill becomes the major remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What remains is the major remainder.

sentences.zh: 命以甲子算外，即所求年天正合朔經日及小餘也。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from jiazi; that is the canonical day of the heavenly-standard conjunction for the year sought and its minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from jiazi; the result is the canonical winter new-moon day for the year sought, with its minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及弦望因天正經朔大小餘，以四象之策及餘加之。

translations.literal: To seek the next new moon and quarter and full moons, take the major and minor remainders of the heavenly-standard canonical new moon and add the four-image stalks and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find successive new moons and the quarter and full moons, add the four-image interval and remainder to the major and minor remainders of the winter canonical new moon.

sentences.zh: 數除如法，即次朔經日及餘也。

translations.literal: Divide the numbers per the method; that is the canonical day of the next new moon and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the numbers by the usual rules; the result is the canonical day of the next new moon with remainder.

sentences.zh: 又自經朔加一象之日七及餘一千一百六十三少，得上弦。

translations.literal: Again from the canonical new moon add one image’s days, seven, and remainder 1,163 lesser, to obtain first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: From the canonical new moon, add one four-image interval—seven days and remainder 1,163 lesser—to obtain the first quarter.

sentences.zh: 倍之，得望。

translations.literal: Double it to obtain full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain full moon.

sentences.zh: 參之，得下弦。

translations.literal: Triple it to obtain last quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Triple it to obtain last quarter.

sentences.zh: 四之，是謂一揲，復得後月之朔。

translations.literal: Quadruple it; this is called one sorting, and again obtain the next month’s new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Quadruple it—one full sorting—to obtain the next month’s new moon.

sentences.zh: 凡四分一為少，二為半，三為太，四為全。

translations.literal: Of every four parts, one is “less,” two are “half,” three are “greater,” four are “full.”
translations.idiomatic: In quartering remainders, one part is lesser, two are half, three are greater, and four are full.

sentences.zh: 加滿其前數，去之，從上位。

translations.literal: When addition fills the preceding number, remove it and carry to the upper position.
translations.idiomatic: When addition fills the prior place, cast it out and carry upward.

sentences.zh: 綜中朔盈虛分，累益歸餘之卦，每其月閏衰。

translations.literal: Combine central and new-moon surplus and void fractions, cumulatively increasing the returned-remainder hexagram; each month the intercalation wanes.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the central surplus and new-moon void fractions, steadily increasing the intercalation pendulum; each month the intercalation fraction diminishes.

sentences.zh: 凡歸餘之卦五萬六千七百六十以上，其歲有閏。

translations.literal: Whenever the returned-remainder hexagram is 56,760 or above, that year has an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the intercalation pendulum reaches 56,760 or more, the year receives an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 因考其閏衰，滿卦限以上，其月及合置閏。

translations.literal: Examining its intercalation wane, when full above the hexagram limit, that month should receive intercalation.
translations.idiomatic: Track the intercalation wane; when it exceeds the intercalation threshold, assign an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 或有進退，皆以定朔無中氣裁焉。

translations.literal: Whether advancing or retreating, all are trimmed by the fixed new moon without central qi.
translations.idiomatic: Whether advancing or retreating, the rule is the fixed new moon in a month without central qi.

sentences.zh: 推沒日置有沒之氣恆小餘，以象統乘之，內秒分，參而伍之，以減策實。

translations.literal: To seek the extinction day, set the constant minor remainder of the qi that has extinction; multiply by the image cycle, include parts and seconds, combine and quintuple, and subtract from stalk substance.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the extinction day, take the constant minor remainder of the qi subject to extinction, multiply by the image cycle, include seconds, combine and quintuple, and subtract from the year-fraction constant.

sentences.zh: 餘滿策餘，為日。

translations.literal: When the remainder fills stalk remainder, it becomes days.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder fills the stalk remainder, the quotient is days.

sentences.zh: 不滿，為沒餘。

translations.literal: When it does not fill, it is extinction remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill is the extinction remainder.

sentences.zh: 命起也。

translations.literal: Fix the count from the start.
translations.idiomatic: Fix the count from the starting day.

sentences.zh: 凡恆氣小餘，不滿大衍通法，如中盈分半法已下，為有沒之氣。

translations.literal: Whenever for a constant qi the minor remainder does not fill the Great Extension universal method and is half the central surplus fraction or below, it is a qi that has extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a constant qi’s minor remainder is less than the Dayan universal divisor and no more than half the central surplus fraction, that qi is subject to extinction.

sentences.zh: 推滅日以有滅之朔經小餘，減大衍通法。

translations.literal: To seek the extinguishing day, take the canonical minor remainder of the new moon that has extinguishing and subtract the Great Extension universal method.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the lunar extinguishing day, take the canonical minor remainder of the new moon subject to extinguishing and subtract the Dayan universal divisor.

sentences.zh: 餘，倍參伍乘之，用減滅法。

translations.literal: The remainder, doubled and quintupled and multiplied, is used to subtract from the reduction method.
translations.idiomatic: Double and quintuple the remainder, then subtract from the reduction constant.

sentences.zh: 餘，滿朔虛分，為日。

translations.literal: The remainder, when full of new-moon void fraction, becomes days.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder fills the new-moon void fraction, the quotient is days.

sentences.zh: 不滿，為滅餘。

translations.literal: When it does not fill, it is extinguishing remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill is the extinguishing remainder.

sentences.zh: 命起經朔初日算外，即合朔後滅日也。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from the first day of the canonical new moon; that is the extinguishing day after conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the first day of the canonical new moon; the result is the lunar extinguishing day after conjunction.

sentences.zh: 凡經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者，為有滅之朔。

translations.literal: Whenever the canonical new moon’s minor remainder does not fill the new-moon void fraction, it is a new moon that has extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a canonical new moon’s minor remainder is less than the new-moon void fraction, that new moon is subject to extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 推七十二候各因中節大小餘命之，即初候日也。

translations.literal: To seek the seventy-two hou, for each fix by the major and minor remainders of the mid-node of the central qi; that is the first hou day.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the seventy-two phenological hou, for each start from the major and minor remainders of the central qi’s mid-node; the result is the first hou day.

sentences.zh: 以天中之策及餘秒加之，數除如法，即次候日。

translations.literal: Add the heaven-central stalks with remainder and parts; divide the numbers per the method; that is the next hou day.
translations.idiomatic: Add the heaven-central interval with remainder and parts, reduce by the usual rules, and obtain the next hou day.

sentences.zh: 又加，得末候日。

translations.literal: Add again to obtain the last hou day.
translations.idiomatic: Add again to obtain the last hou day.

sentences.zh: 凡發斂，皆以恆氣。

translations.literal: All issuing and gathering in use constant qi.
translations.idiomatic: All issuing-and-gathering-in calculations use constant qi.

sentences.zh: 推六十卦各因中氣大小餘命之，公卦用事日也。

translations.literal: To seek the sixty hexagrams, for each fix by the major and minor remainders of the central qi; that is the day when the duke hexagram governs.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the sixty hexagrams, for each start from the major and minor remainders of the central qi; the result is the day when the duke hexagram governs.

sentences.zh: 以地之策及餘秒累加之，數除如法，各次卦用事日。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add the earth stalks with remainder and parts; divide the numbers per the method; each is the day when the next hexagram governs.
translations.idiomatic: Keep adding the earth-central interval with remainder and parts, reduce by the usual rules, and obtain each successive hexagram’s governing day.

sentences.zh: 若以貞晦之策加諸候卦，得十二節之初外卦用事日。

translations.literal: If one adds the zhen-hui stalks to the marquis hexagrams, one obtains the day when the outer hexagram of the twelve nodes governs at their beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Alternatively, add the zhen-hui interval to the marquis hexagrams to obtain when the outer hexagram of the twelve nodes governs at their opening.

sentences.zh: 推五行用事各因四立大小餘命之，即春木、夏火、秋金、冬水首用事日也。

translations.literal: To seek when the Five Phases govern, for each fix by the major and minor remainders of the four establishments; that is the first governing day of spring Wood, summer Fire, autumn Metal, and winter Water.
translations.idiomatic: To determine when the Five Phases govern, for each start from the major and minor remainders of the four establishment days; the result is the first governing day of spring Wood, summer Fire, autumn Metal, and winter Water.

sentences.zh: 以貞晦之策及餘秒，減四季中氣大小餘，即其月土始用事日。

translations.literal: Subtract the zhen-hui stalks with remainder and parts from the major and minor remainders of the central qi of the four seasons; that is the day when Earth first governs in that month.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the zhen-hui interval and its remainder and parts from the last seasonal month’s central qi; the result is the day when Earth the King first governs.

sentences.zh: 凡抽加減而有秒者，母若不齊，當令母互乘子。

translations.literal: Whenever adding or subtracting with parts and the denominators are not equal, let the denominators cross-multiply the numerators.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever addition or subtraction involves seconds and the denominators differ, cross-multiply numerators by the opposite denominators.

sentences.zh: 乃加減之。

translations.literal: Then add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Then add or subtract.

sentences.zh: 母相乘為法。

translations.literal: Denominators multiplied together form the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: The product of denominators is the common divisor.

sentences.zh: 推發斂去朔各置其月閏衰，以大衍通法約之，為日。

translations.literal: To seek issuing and gathering in from new moon, for each set the month’s intercalation wane and reduce by the Great Extension universal method to obtain days.
translations.idiomatic: To determine issuing and gathering in from the new moon, for each month divide the intercalation wane by the Dayan universal divisor to obtain days.

sentences.zh: 不盡為餘，即其月中氣去經朔日算及餘秒也。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is remainder; that is the day-count from central qi to canonical new moon in that month and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder gives the interval from central qi to canonical new moon in that month, with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 求卦候者，各以天地之策及餘秒累加減之，中氣之前以減，中氣之後以加。

translations.literal: To seek hexagrams and hou, for each cumulatively add or subtract heaven- and earth-central stalks with remainder and parts; before central qi subtract, after central qi add.
translations.idiomatic: To determine hexagrams and phenological hou, cumulatively add or subtract the heaven- and earth-central intervals with remainder and parts—subtract before central qi, add after.

sentences.zh: 得去經朔日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: Obtain the day-count from canonical new moon and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: The result is the interval from canonical new moon with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 推發斂加時各置其小餘，以六爻乘之，如辰法而一，為半辰之數。

translations.literal: To seek the time of issuing and gathering in, for each set the minor remainder, multiply by six lines, take one per chronogram method, as the half-chronogram number.
translations.idiomatic: To fix the time of issuing and gathering in, set each minor remainder, multiply by six lines, and divide by the chronogram divisor to obtain the half-chronogram count.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，五之，三刻法除之，為刻。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, multiply by five, divide by three clepsydra methods, as clepsydra marks.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, multiplied by five and divided by three times the clepsydra divisor, gives clepsydra notches.

sentences.zh: 又不盡者，三約為分。

translations.literal: What again does not exhaust, reduce by three to obtain parts.
translations.idiomatic: Any remainder still left, divided by three, gives fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 此分滿刻法為刻，若令滿象積為刻者，即置不盡之數，十之，十九而一，為分。

translations.literal: When these parts fill the clepsydra method they become clepsydra marks; if one lets the image accumulation fill clepsydra marks, set the unexhausted number, multiply by ten, and one per nineteen becomes parts.
translations.idiomatic: When the parts fill the clepsydra divisor they become notches; if the image accumulation is to fill clepsydra marks directly, take the remainder, multiply by ten, and divide by nineteen for the parts.

sentences.zh: 命起子半算外，各其加時所在辰刻及分也。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from the half of zi; each is the chronogram, clepsydra mark, and parts of the time added.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the midpoint of zi; the result is the chronogram, clepsydra notch, and fractional parts for each added time.

translations.literal: Annual difference: 36 and greater.
translations.idiomatic: Precession per year: 36 and greater.

sentences.zh: 求每日先後定數以所入氣並後氣盈縮分，倍六爻乘之，綜兩氣辰數除，入之，為末率。

translations.literal: To seek the daily prior-and-posterior fixed tally, take the expansion–contraction fractions of the entered qi together with the following qi, double and multiply by six lines, divide by the combined chronogram counts of both qi and enter it, obtaining the terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: To determine each day’s lead-and-lag fixed tally, combine the expansion–contraction fractions of the current and next qi, double and multiply by six lines, divide by the sum of their chronogram counts, and obtain the terminal rate.

sentences.zh: 又列二氣盈縮分，皆倍六爻乘之，各如辰數而一，以少減多，餘為氣差。

translations.literal: Again set out the expansion–contraction fractions of both qi; each is doubled and multiplied by six lines, and one per chronogram count is taken; subtract the smaller from the larger; the remainder is the qi difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set out both qi’s expansion–contraction fractions, each doubled and multiplied by six lines and divided by its chronogram count; subtract the smaller from the larger; the remainder is the qi difference.

sentences.zh: 加減末率，至後以差加，分後以差減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to the terminal rate: after the solstice add the difference; after the equinox subtract the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust the terminal rate: after a solstice add the difference; after an equinox subtract it.

sentences.zh: 為初率。

translations.literal: This becomes the initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the initial rate.

sentences.zh: 倍氣差，亦六爻乘之，復綜兩氣辰數以除之，為日差。

translations.literal: Double the qi difference, likewise multiply by six lines, again divide by the combined chronogram counts of both qi, obtaining the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the qi difference, multiply by six lines, divide again by the combined chronogram counts of both qi, and obtain the day difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，以加減初末，各為定率。

translations.literal: Halve it and add or subtract from initial and terminal rates; each becomes a fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the day difference and add or subtract from the initial and terminal rates to obtain the fixed rates.

sentences.zh: 以日差累加減氣初定率，至後以差減，分後以差加。

translations.literal: With the day difference cumulatively add or subtract to the initial fixed rate of the qi: after the solstice subtract the difference; after the equinox add the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Using the day difference, adjust the qi’s initial fixed rate step by step: subtract after a solstice and add after an equinox.

sentences.zh: 為每日盈縮分。

translations.literal: This becomes the daily expansion–contraction fraction.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the daily expansion–contraction fraction.

sentences.zh: 乃馴積之，隨所入氣日加減氣下先後數，各其日定。

translations.literal: Then accumulate evenly; day by day within the entered qi add or subtract the prior-and-posterior numbers below the qi; each day is fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate stepwise: for each day within the entered qi, add or subtract the lead and lag counts listed under that qi to fix each day’s tally.

sentences.zh: 冬至後為陽復，在盈加之，在縮減之。

translations.literal: After the Winter Solstice is yang recovery: where expansion, add; where contraction, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter Solstice is yang recovery: add in expansion and subtract in contraction.

sentences.zh: 夏至後為陰復，在縮加之，在盈減之。

translations.literal: After the Summer Solstice is yin recovery: where contraction, add; where expansion, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: After the Summer Solstice is yin recovery: add in contraction and subtract in expansion.

sentences.zh: 距四正前一氣，在陰陽變革之際，不可相並，皆因前末為初率。

translations.literal: One qi before each of the four cardinal points, at the turn of yin and yang, cannot be combined; therefore take the prior terminal as the initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: For the qi immediately before each cardinal solstice or equinox, at the yin–yang transition the rates cannot be merged; use the prior qi’s terminal rate as the initial rate.

sentences.zh: 以氣差至前加之，分前減之，為末率。

translations.literal: Before the solstice add the qi difference; before the equinox subtract the qi difference; this becomes the terminal rate.
translations.idiomatic: Before a solstice add the qi difference to obtain the terminal rate; before an equinox subtract it.

sentences.zh: 餘依前率，各得所求。

translations.literal: For the remainder, follow the prior rates; each sought value is thereby obtained.
translations.idiomatic: For the rest, follow the rates above; each quantity sought is thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 其朓朒亦放此求之，各得每日定數。

translations.literal: Waxing and waning accumulations are also sought by this same method; each day’s fixed tally is thereby obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Waxing and waning accumulations are determined by the same procedure, yielding each day’s fixed tally.

sentences.zh: 其分不滿全數，母又每氣不同，當退法除之，用百為母，半已上從一，已下棄之。

translations.literal: When the parts do not fill the whole number and the denominators differ for each qi, the divisor must be reduced accordingly; take one hundred as the denominator; at half or above, carry to one; below that, discard.
translations.idiomatic: When fractional parts do not make a full unit and each qi has a different denominator, reduce by retreating the divisor; use one hundred as the denominator; at one-half or above, round up to one; below that, discard.

sentences.zh: 下求軌漏，餘分不滿准此。

translations.literal: In seeking orbital motion and clepsydra marks below, fractional remainders that do not fill follow this same rule.
translations.idiomatic: In lower steps for orbital motion and clepsydra marks, apply the same rule to remainders that do not fill a unit.

sentences.zh: 推二十四氣定日冬夏至皆在天地之中，無有盈縮。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed days of the twenty-four qi: at Winter and Summer Solstice alike both are at the heaven–earth mean; there is no expansion or contraction.
translations.idiomatic: To fix the days of the twenty-four qi: at the Winter and Summer Solstices the sun reaches the cosmological mean, with neither expansion nor contraction.

sentences.zh: 餘各以氣下先後數，先減後加恆氣小餘。

translations.literal: For the rest, with the prior-and-posterior numbers below each qi first subtract and then add to the minor remainder of constant qi.
translations.idiomatic: For the remaining qi, first subtract then add the lead and lag counts under each qi to the constant qi’s minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，進退其日。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day.
translations.idiomatic: Carry or borrow days as needed.

sentences.zh: 命從甲子算外，各其定日及餘秒也。

translations.literal: Fix the count outward from jiazi; each has its fixed day and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from jiazi; the result is each qi’s fixed day with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 凡推日月行度及軌漏交蝕，並依定氣。

translations.literal: For all computations of solar and lunar motion, orbital motion and clepsydra, and eclipses, all rely on fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: All calculations of solar and lunar longitude, orbital motion, clepsydra marks, and eclipses use fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 若注曆即依恆氣也。

translations.literal: If entering a calendar, then rely on constant qi.
translations.idiomatic: Published calendars, however, follow constant qi.

sentences.zh: 推平朔四象以定氣相距置朔弦望經日大小餘，以所入定氣大小餘及秒分減之，各其所入定氣日算及餘秒也。

translations.literal: To seek mean new moons and the four images: set the major and minor remainders of canonical new, quarter, and full moons at the distance of fixed qi; subtract the major and minor remainders and parts and seconds of the entered fixed qi; each yields the entered fixed qi’s day count and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean new moons and the four phases: set the canonical new-, quarter-, and full-moon major and minor remainders at the fixed-qi interval, subtract the entered fixed qi’s major and minor remainders with seconds and parts, and obtain each entered fixed qi’s day count with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 若大餘少不足減者，加爻數，然後減之。

translations.literal: If the major remainder is too small to subtract, add the line count, then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the major remainder is too small to subtract, add sixty lines, then subtract.

sentences.zh: 其弦望小餘有少半太，當以爻乘之，乃以氣秒分減，退一加象統。

translations.literal: When the minor remainder for quarter or full moon has lesser, half, or greater parts, multiply by the line count; then subtract the qi’s parts and seconds; retreat one and add the image cycle.
translations.idiomatic: When a quarter or full moon’s minor remainder includes lesser, half, or greater fractions, multiply by the line count, subtract the qi’s seconds and parts, retreat one place, and add the image cycle.

sentences.zh: 小餘不足減，退日算一，加大衍通法也。

translations.literal: If the minor remainder is insufficient to subtract, retreat the day count by one and add the Great Extension universal method.
translations.idiomatic: If the minor remainder is too small to subtract, borrow one day and add the Dayan universal divisor.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望經日入朓朒各置其所入定氣日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek canonical new, quarter, and full moons entering waxing and waning, for each set the entered fixed qi’s day count and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find each canonical syzygy’s waxing–waning entry, set the entered fixed qi’s day count with remainder and parts.

sentences.zh: 減日算一，各以日差乘而半之，以加減其氣初定率，前少，加之；

translations.literal: Subtract one from the day count; for each multiply by the day difference and halve it; add or subtract to the initial fixed rate of the qi: if the prior is less, add;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one from the day count, multiply by the day difference and halve, then adjust the qi’s initial fixed rate: if the prior fraction is smaller, add;

sentences.zh: 前多，減之。

translations.literal: if the prior is more, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: if larger, subtract.

sentences.zh: 以乘其所入定氣日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: Multiply by the entered fixed qi’s day count and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the entered fixed qi’s day count, remainder, and parts.

sentences.zh: 凡除者，先以母通全，內子，乃相乘，母相乘除之也。

translations.literal: For all divisions, first convert wholes through the denominator and include the numerator, then multiply; denominators multiply and divide.
translations.idiomatic: In every division, first unify whole units through the denominator, include the numerator, then multiply and divide by the denominators.

sentences.zh: 若忽微之數煩多而不甚相校者，過半收為全，不盈半法，棄之。

translations.literal: If minute numbers are numerous and not much compared, at more than half collect into a whole; what does not fill half the method is discarded.
translations.idiomatic: When minute quantities are too numerous to compare closely, round up at more than half a unit and discard what falls below half the divisor.

sentences.zh: 所得以損益朓朒積，各為其日所入朓朒定數。

translations.literal: Use what is obtained to increase or decrease the waxing–waning accumulation; each is that day’s entered waxing–waning fixed tally.
translations.idiomatic: Use the result to adjust the waxing–waning accumulation, obtaining each day’s entered waxing–waning fixed tally.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交者，以十二乘所入日算。

translations.literal: If it is not a syzygy with an eclipse at new or full moon, multiply the entered day count by twelve.
translations.idiomatic: When new or full moon is not an eclipse syzygy, multiply the entered day count by twelve.

sentences.zh: 三其小餘，辰法除而從之。

translations.literal: Triple the minor remainder; divide by the chronogram method and add it.
translations.idiomatic: Triple the minor remainder, divide by the chronogram divisor, and add the quotient.

sentences.zh: 以乘損益率，如定氣辰數而一。

translations.literal: Multiply by the increase-decrease rate; take one per fixed-qi chronogram count.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the rate of increase or decrease, and divide by the fixed-qi chronogram count.

sentences.zh: 所得以損益朓朒積，各為定數也。

translations.literal: Use what is obtained to increase or decrease the waxing–waning accumulation; each becomes a fixed tally.
translations.idiomatic: Use the result to adjust the waxing–waning accumulation, yielding a fixed value for each entry.

sentences.zh: 赤道宿度

translations.literal: Equatorial lodge degrees
translations.idiomatic: Equatorial Lodge Degrees

sentences.zh: 右北方七宿九十八度虛分七百七十九太

translations.literal: At right: the seven northern lodges, 98 degrees, void fraction 779 and greater.
translations.idiomatic: Northern quarter (seven lodges): 98°, void fraction 779 and greater.

sentences.zh: 右西方七宿八十一度

translations.literal: At right: the seven western lodges, 81 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Western quarter (seven lodges): 81°.

sentences.zh: 右東方七宿七十五度

translations.literal: At right: the seven eastern lodges, 75 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern quarter (seven lodges): 75°.

sentences.zh: 前皆赤道度。

translations.literal: The foregoing are all equatorial degrees.
translations.idiomatic: These are all equatorial longitudes.

sentences.zh: 其畢、觜、參及輿鬼四宿度數，與古不同，今並依天以儀測定，用為常數。

translations.literal: The degree-counts of the four lodges Net, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Ghost Cart differ from antiquity; now all are measured by instrument according to heaven and taken as constants.
translations.idiomatic: The arc-degrees assigned to Net, Turtle Beak, Three Stars, and Ghost Cart differ from the ancient reckoning; they are now fixed by armillary measurement against the sky and adopted as standard constants.

sentences.zh: 紘帶天中，儀極攸憑，以格黃道也。

translations.literal: The girdle spans heaven’s center; the instrument’s pole is relied upon to mark off the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: The celestial girdle runs through heaven’s center; the polar axis of the instrument is the reference for laying out the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 推黃道，准冬至歲差所在，每距冬至前後各五度為限。

translations.literal: To seek the Yellow Path: according to where the winter-solstice annual difference lies, each five degrees before and after the winter solstice is one limit.
translations.idiomatic: To determine the ecliptic: find where the winter-solstice precession applies, taking five degrees on either side of the solstice as one band.

sentences.zh: 初數十二，每限減一，盡九限，數終於四。

translations.literal: The initial count is twelve; each limit reduces by one; through nine limits the count ends at four.
translations.idiomatic: Begin at twelve and subtract one for each successive band; after nine bands the tally reaches four.

sentences.zh: 殷二立之際，一度少強，依平。

translations.literal: At the two Establishment nodes, one degree slightly strong; follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the two Establishment qi, treat one degree as slightly strong and use the mean value.

sentences.zh: 乃距春分前、秋分後，初限起四，每限增一，盡九限，終於十二，而黃道交復。

translations.literal: Then from before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, the initial limit begins at four; each limit adds one; through nine limits it ends at twelve, and the Yellow Path intersection returns.
translations.idiomatic: From before the spring equinox and after the autumn equinox, begin the first band at four and add one per band; after nine bands the tally is twelve, and the ecliptic obliquity cycle completes.

sentences.zh: 計春分後、秋分前，亦五度為限，初數十二，盡九限，數終於四。

translations.literal: Count likewise after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, again with five degrees per limit; the initial count is twelve; through nine limits the count ends at four.
translations.idiomatic: For the interval after the spring equinox and before the autumn equinox, use the same five-degree bands; begin at twelve; after nine bands the tally reaches four.

sentences.zh: 殷二立之際，一度少強，依平。

translations.literal: At the two Establishment nodes, one degree slightly strong; follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: At the two Establishment qi, treat one degree as slightly strong and use the mean value.

sentences.zh: 乃距夏至前後，初限起四，盡九限，終於十二。

translations.literal: Then before and after the summer solstice, the initial limit begins at four; through nine limits it ends at twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after the summer solstice, begin the first band at four; after nine bands the tally is twelve.

sentences.zh: 皆累裁之，以數乘限度，百二十而一，得度。

translations.literal: Trim cumulatively in each case; multiply the limit-count by the band-number; divide by 120 to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the trims in order, multiply the band index by the limit value, and divide by 120 to obtain degrees.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，十二除為分。

translations.literal: What does not fill, divide by twelve for parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by twelve, gives fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 若以十除，則大分。

translations.literal: If one divides by ten, the major parts are large.
translations.idiomatic: If divided by ten instead, the major parts become too large.

sentences.zh: 十二為母，命乙太半少及強弱。

translations.literal: Take twelve as the denominator; name greater, half, lesser, and strong or weak.
translations.idiomatic: Use twelve as the denominator, naming greater, half, lesser, strong, and weak fractions.

sentences.zh: 命曰黃赤道差數。

translations.literal: Name it the yellow–red path difference number.
translations.idiomatic: This is called the ecliptic–equator difference.

sentences.zh: 二至前後，各九限，以差減赤道度，為黃道度。

translations.literal: For nine limits before and after each solstice, subtract the difference from equatorial degrees to obtain ecliptic degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Within nine bands on either side of each solstice, subtract the difference from the equatorial longitude to obtain ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 二分前後，各九限，以差加赤道度，為黃道度。

translations.literal: For nine limits before and after each equinox, add the difference to equatorial degrees to obtain ecliptic degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Within nine bands on either side of each equinox, add the difference to the equatorial longitude to obtain ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 若從黃道度反推赤道，二至前後各加之，二分前後須減之。

translations.literal: If working back from ecliptic degrees to seek the equator, before and after each solstice add the difference; before and after each equinox subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: To convert ecliptic longitude back to equatorial, add the difference near solstices and subtract it near equinoxes.

sentences.zh: 黃道宿度

translations.literal: Yellow Path lodge degrees
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic Lodge Degrees

sentences.zh: 右北方九十七度六虛之差十九太

translations.literal: At right: the north, 97 degrees, six void differences 19 and greater.
translations.idiomatic: Northern quarter: 97°, six void-difference parts 19 and greater.

sentences.zh: 右西方八十二度半

translations.literal: At right: the west, 82½ degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Western quarter: 82½°.

sentences.zh: 右南方一百一十度半

translations.literal: At right: the south, 110½ degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Southern quarter: 110½°.

sentences.zh: 右東方七十五度少

translations.literal: At right: the east, 75 degrees lesser.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern quarter: 75° lesser.

sentences.zh: 前皆黃道度。

translations.literal: The foregoing are all Yellow Path degrees.
translations.idiomatic: These are all ecliptic longitudes.

sentences.zh: 其步日行月與五星出入，循此。

translations.literal: Pacing the sun day by day, the moon, and the five planets entering and exiting all follow this.
translations.idiomatic: The sun’s daily motion, the moon, and the five planets are all reckoned by this ecliptic framework.

sentences.zh: 求此宿度，皆有餘分。

translations.literal: In seeking these lodge degrees, all have surplus parts.
translations.idiomatic: These lodge longitudes all carry fractional remainders.

sentences.zh: 前後輩之成少、半、太，准為全度。

translations.literal: Earlier and later generations round them to lesser, half, or greater, aligning them to whole degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Successive reckonings round them to lesser, half, or greater parts to align with whole degrees.

sentences.zh: 若上考古下驗將來，當據歲差。

translations.literal: If examining antiquity above and testing the future below, one should follow the annual difference.
translations.idiomatic: To verify against past ages and test future ones, apply the precession.

sentences.zh: 每移一度，各依術算，使得當時宿度及分，然可步日月五星，知其犯守也。

translations.literal: For each degree it shifts, compute by the method so as to obtain the lodge degrees and parts of that time; only then can one pace the sun, moon, and five planets and know their violations and stations.
translations.idiomatic: For each degree of shift, recalculate by the method to obtain contemporary longitudes — only then may one pace the sun, moon, and planets and know their stations and transgressions.

sentences.zh: 推日度以乾實去中積分。

translations.literal: To seek solar degrees, subtract circuit-of-heaven substance from the central accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To determine solar longitude, subtract the circuit-of-heaven constant from the central accumulation.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，盈大衍通法為度。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust, fill the Great Extension universal method to obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by the Dayan universal divisor, gives degrees.

sentences.zh: 不滿，為度餘。

translations.literal: What does not fill becomes the degree remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What remains is the degree remainder.

sentences.zh: 命起赤道虛九，去分。

translations.literal: Fix the count from equatorial Emptiness 9; remove the fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Count from equatorial Emptiness 9°, subtracting the fraction.

sentences.zh: 不滿宿算外，即所求年天正冬至加時日所在度及餘也。

translations.literal: When less than one lodge remains outside the count, that is the degree and remainder where the sun stands at hour-addition on the heavenly-standard winter solstice for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: When less than one lodge remains beyond the tally, the result is the solar longitude at winter-solstice hour-addition for the year sought, with its remainder.

sentences.zh: 以三元之策累加之，命宿次如前，各得氣初日加時赤道宿度。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add the three-origin interval; fix the lodge sequence as before; each yields the equatorial lodge degree at hour-addition on the first day of each qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add the three-origin interval repeatedly and count through the lodges as before to obtain the equatorial longitude at hour-addition on the first day of each qi.

sentences.zh: 求黃道日度以度餘減大衍通法。

translations.literal: To seek ecliptic solar degrees, subtract the degree remainder from the Great Extension universal method.
translations.idiomatic: To determine ecliptic solar longitude, subtract the degree remainder from the Dayan universal divisor.

sentences.zh: 餘以冬至日躔之宿距度所入限乘之，為距前分。

translations.literal: Multiply the remainder by the limit of the winter-solstice solar station’s distance-degree entry to obtain the pre-distance fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the band index for the winter-solstice solar station’s distance entry to obtain the pre-distance fraction.

sentences.zh: 置距度下黃赤道差，以大衍通法乘之，減去距前分。

translations.literal: Set the yellow–red path difference below the distance degree; multiply by the Great Extension universal method and subtract the pre-distance fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Take the ecliptic–equator difference for the distance band, multiply by the Dayan universal divisor, and subtract the pre-distance fraction.

sentences.zh: 餘，滿百二十除，為定差。

translations.literal: When the remainder fills 120, divide to obtain the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the remainder fills 120, divide to obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，以象統乘之。

translations.literal: What does not fill, multiply by the image cycle.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not fill, multiply by the image cycle.

sentences.zh: 復除，為秒分。

translations.literal: Divide again for seconds and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide again to obtain seconds and parts.

sentences.zh: 乃以定差及秒減赤道宿度。

translations.literal: Then subtract the fixed difference and seconds from the equatorial lodge degree.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the fixed difference and seconds from the equatorial lodge longitude.

sentences.zh: 餘，依前命之，即天正冬至加時所在黃道宿度及餘也。

translations.literal: The remainder, fixed as before, is the Yellow Path lodge degree and remainder where the heavenly-standard winter solstice stands at hour-addition.
translations.idiomatic: Fix the remainder as before; the result is the ecliptic longitude at winter-solstice hour-addition, with its remainder.

sentences.zh: 求次定氣置歲差，以限數乘之，滿百二十除，為秒分。

translations.literal: To seek the next fixed qi, set the annual difference; multiply by the limit-number; divide by 120 for seconds and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find successive fixed qi, set the annual precession, multiply by the band index, and divide by 120 for seconds and parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡為小分。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust becomes minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder becomes minor parts.

sentences.zh: 以加於三元之策秒分，因累而裁之，命以黃道宿次去之，各得定氣加時日躔所在宿及餘也。

translations.literal: Add to the parts and seconds of the three-origin interval; trim cumulatively; fix the count by Yellow Path lodge sequence and remove; each yields the lodge and remainder where the sun’s station stands at hour-addition for fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the three-origin interval’s seconds and parts, accumulate the trims in order, and count through the ecliptic lodges to obtain the solar station at hour-addition for each fixed qi, with remainder.

sentences.zh: 求定氣初日夜半日所在度各置其氣定小餘，副之，以乘其日盈縮分，滿大衍通法而一，盈加縮減其副，用減其日時度餘，命如前，各其日夜半日躔行在。

translations.literal: To seek the degree where the sun stands at midnight on the first day of each fixed qi, for each set that qi’s fixed minor remainder and keep a duplicate; multiply by its daily expansion–contraction fraction; divide by the Great Extension universal method; expansion adds and contraction subtracts from the duplicate; use this to subtract from the hour-added degree remainder for that day; fix as before; each yields where the sun’s station moves at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To find midnight solar longitude on the first day of each fixed qi, set the fixed minor remainder and keep a duplicate; multiply by the daily equation of time, divide by the Dayan universal divisor, add or subtract from the duplicate according to surplus or deficit, subtract from the hour-added degree remainder, and fix as before to obtain midnight solar longitude.

sentences.zh: 求次日，各因定氣初日夜半度，累加一策，乃以其日盈縮分，盈加縮減度餘，命以宿次，即半日所在度及餘也。

translations.literal: To seek the next day, for each take the midnight degree on the first day of fixed qi and cumulatively add one interval; then with that day’s expansion–contraction fraction, expansion adds and contraction subtracts from the degree remainder; fix by lodge sequence; that is the degree and remainder where the sun stands at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: For each following day, start from the first-day midnight longitude, add one interval at each step, apply that day’s equation to the degree remainder by addition or subtraction, and count through the lodges to obtain midnight solar longitude with remainder.

sentences.zh: 大衍步月離術第四

translations.literal: Great Extension: Pacing Lunar Motion, Section Four
translations.idiomatic: Dayan Calendar: Method for Lunar Motion, IV

sentences.zh: 轉終分：六百七十萬一千二百七十九。

translations.literal: Rotation cycle parts: 670,1279.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation cycle constant: 670,1279.

sentences.zh: 轉終日：二十七；

translations.literal: Rotation cycle days: 27;
translations.idiomatic: Rotation cycle: 27 days;

sentences.zh: 餘，一千六百八十五；

translations.literal: remainder, 1,685;
translations.idiomatic: remainder 1,685;

sentences.zh: 秒，七十九。

translations.literal: parts, 79.
translations.idiomatic: 79 parts.

sentences.zh: 轉法：七十六。

translations.literal: Rotation divisor: 76.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation divisor: 76.

sentences.zh: 轉秒法：八十。

translations.literal: Rotation second-fraction divisor: 80.
translations.idiomatic: Rotation second-fraction divisor: 80.

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔入轉以轉終分去朔積分，不盡，以秒法乘，盈轉終分又去之，餘如秒法一而入轉分。

translations.literal: To derive the celestial first month canonical new moon rotation entry: remove the new-moon accumulated fraction by the rotation terminal fraction; what is not exhausted, multiply by the second-fraction divisor; when it fills the rotation terminal fraction remove it again; the remainder, as one per second-fraction divisor, gives rotation entry parts.
translations.idiomatic: To calculate rotation entry at the celestial first month's canonical new moon, divide the new-moon accumulated fraction by the rotation terminal fraction; multiply the remainder by the second-fraction divisor and cast out full rotation terminal fractions again; divide the remainder by the second-fraction divisor to obtain rotation entry parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡為秒。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted are second-fractions.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted are second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 入轉分滿大衍通法，為日。

translations.literal: When rotation entry parts fill the Dayan universal divisor, that makes days.
translations.idiomatic: When rotation entry parts fill the Dayan universal divisor, each full unit counts as one day.

sentences.zh: 不滿為餘。

translations.literal: What does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill is the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，即所求年天正經朔加時入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: Count outward from the day tally—that is the rotation entry day and remainder seconds at the hour of addition for the celestial first month canonical new moon of the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the day tally to obtain the rotation entry day and second-fractions at the hour of occurrence for the celestial first month's canonical new moon of the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求次朔入轉因天正所入轉差日一、轉餘二千九百六十七、秒分一，盈轉終日餘秒者去之。

translations.literal: To find the next new moon rotation entry: from the celestial first month rotation entry, add rotation difference one day, rotation remainder 2,967, and one second-fraction; cast out what fills the rotation terminal days and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next new moon's rotation entry, add to the celestial first month's entry a rotation increment of one day, remainder 2,967, and one second-fraction; cast out full rotation terminal days and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 數除如前，即次日經朔加時所入。

translations.literal: Divide and count as before—that is the entry at the next day's canonical new moon hour of addition.
translations.idiomatic: Divide and assign as before to obtain the entry at the next day's canonical new moon hour of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 考上下弦望，如求經朔四象術，循變相加，若以經朔望小餘減之，各其日夜半所入轉日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To verify first and last quarters and full moon: as in the method for finding canonical new moon four phases, add sequential variations; if subtracting the canonical new-moon or full-moon small remainder, each gives the rotation entry day and remainder seconds at that night's midnight.
translations.idiomatic: To verify the first and last quarters and full moon, apply the four-phase method for canonical new moons and add each variation in turn; subtracting each canonical new-moon or full-moon small remainder yields the rotation entry day and second-fractions at that night's midnight.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望入朓朒定數各朔其所入日損益而半之，為通率。

translations.literal: To find the fixed waxing-waning numbers for new, crescent, and full moon: for each new moon, halve the increase-decrease of the entered day—this is the universal rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed waxing-waning numbers for each syzygy, halve the increase-decrease rate of the entered day at each new moon to obtain the universal rate.

sentences.zh: 又二率相減為率差。

translations.literal: Again subtract the two rates—the difference is the rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two rates; the remainder is the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 前多者，以入餘減大衍通法，餘乘率差，盈大衍通法得一，並率差而半之。

translations.literal: When the prior is greater: subtract the entry remainder from the Dayan universal divisor; multiply the remainder by the rate difference; when it fills the Dayan universal divisor obtain one; combine with the rate difference and halve.
translations.idiomatic: When the prior rate is larger, subtract the entry remainder from the Dayan universal divisor, multiply the remainder by the rate difference, divide by the Dayan universal divisor and round up, then halve together with the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 前少者，半入餘，乘率差，亦以大衍通法除之，為加時轉率。

translations.literal: When the prior is smaller: halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference, and likewise divide by the Dayan universal divisor—this is the hour-added rotation rate.
translations.idiomatic: When the prior rate is smaller, halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference, and divide by the Dayan universal divisor likewise—this yields the hour-added rotation rate.

sentences.zh: 乃半之，以損益加時所入，餘為轉餘。

translations.literal: Then halve it and increase or decrease what is entered at the hour; the remainder is the rotation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Halve this and apply increase or decrease to the hour entry; the remainder is the rotation remainder.

sentences.zh: 其轉餘，應益者，減法；

translations.literal: For the rotation remainder, when increase applies, subtract from the divisor;
translations.idiomatic: For the rotation remainder, when increase applies, subtract from the divisor;

sentences.zh: 應損者，因餘。

translations.literal: when decrease applies, use the remainder as basis.
translations.idiomatic: when decrease applies, use the remainder as basis.

sentences.zh: 皆以乘率差，盈大衍通法得一，加於通率。

translations.literal: In each case multiply by the rate difference; when it fills the Dayan universal divisor obtain one and add to the universal rate.
translations.idiomatic: In each case multiply by the rate difference, divide by the Dayan universal divisor, and add the result to the universal rate.

sentences.zh: 轉率乘之，大衍通法約之，以朓減朒加轉率為定率。

translations.literal: Multiply by the rotation rate and reduce by the Dayan universal divisor; waxing subtract and waning add to the rotation rate—this is the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the rotation rate and reduce by the Dayan universal divisor; subtract for waxing and add for waning to the rotation rate—this yields the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以定率損益朓朒積為定數。

translations.literal: Then with the fixed rate increase or decrease the waxing-waning accumulation to obtain the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed rate to adjust the waxing-waning accumulation, yielding the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 其後無同率者，亦因前率，益者以通率為初數，半率差而減之。

translations.literal: Where no matching rate follows thereafter, likewise follow the prior rate; when increase applies, take the universal rate as the initial number and subtract half the rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: When no matching rate follows, proceed from the prior rate in the same way; when increase applies, take the universal rate as the initial value and subtract half the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 應通率，其損益入餘，進退日者，分為二日，隨餘初末如法求之，所得並以損益轉率。

translations.literal: When the universal rate applies, if increase-decrease in the entry remainder advances or retreats the day, split the parts across two days and, according to initial or terminal remainder, seek by the method; what is obtained is together used to increase or decrease the rotation rate.
translations.idiomatic: When the universal rate applies and adjustment of the entry remainder carries or borrows a day, apportion the parts over two days and compute by initial or terminal remainder as the method requires; use the result together to adjust the rotation rate.

sentences.zh: 此術本出《皇極曆》，以究算術之微變。

translations.literal: This method originally comes from the Huangji calendar, to exhaust the subtle shifts of computational art.
translations.idiomatic: This procedure derives from the Huangji calendar, refining the subtle variations of computational astronomy.

sentences.zh: 若非朔望有交者，直以入餘乘損益，如大衍通法而一，以損益朓朒為定數，各得所求。

translations.literal: If it is not a new or full moon with an eclipse, directly multiply the entry remainder by the increase-decrease, as one per Dayan universal divisor, and with that increase or decrease waxing-waning to obtain the fixed number—each obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: When new or full moon has no eclipse, multiply the entry remainder directly by the increase-decrease rate, divide by the Dayan universal divisor, and adjust waxing-waning accordingly to obtain the fixed number for each syzygy.

sentences.zh: 七日初：二千七百一，約為大分八。

translations.literal: Day seven initial: 2,701, approximating to major fraction eight.
translations.idiomatic: Day 7, initial value: 2,701, approximating to eight major parts.

sentences.zh: 末：三百三十九，約為大分一。

translations.literal: Terminal: 339, approximating to major fraction one.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal value: 339, approximating to one major part.

sentences.zh: 十四日初：二千三百六十三，約為大分七。

translations.literal: Day fourteen initial: 2,363, approximating to major fraction seven.
translations.idiomatic: Day 14, initial value: 2,363, approximating to seven major parts.

sentences.zh: 末：六百七十七，約為大分二。

translations.literal: Terminal: 677, approximating to major fraction two.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal value: 677, approximating to two major parts.

sentences.zh: 二十一日初：二千二十四，約為大分六。

translations.literal: Day twenty-one initial: 2,024, approximating to major fraction six.
translations.idiomatic: Day 21, initial value: 2,024, approximating to six major parts.

sentences.zh: 末：一千一十六，約為大分三。

translations.literal: Terminal: 1,016, approximating to major fraction three.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal value: 1,016, approximating to three major parts.

sentences.zh: 二十八日初：一千六百八十六，約為大分五。

translations.literal: Day twenty-eight initial: 1,686, approximating to major fraction five.
translations.idiomatic: Day 28, initial value: 1,686, approximating to five major parts.

sentences.zh: 末：一千三百五十四，約為大分四。

translations.literal: Terminal: 1,354, approximating to major fraction four.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal value: 1,354, approximating to four major parts.

sentences.zh: 右以四象約轉終日及餘，均得六日二千七百一分。

translations.literal: At right, reduce the rotation terminal days and remainder by the four phases; evenly obtain six days, 2,701 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Above, divide the rotation terminal days and remainder by the four-phase divisor; each segment is six days, 2,701 parts.

sentences.zh: 就全數約為大分，是為之八分。

translations.literal: Reduce the full number to major parts—this is eight parts of it.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the full count to major parts—this is eight parts in nine of a day.

sentences.zh: 以減法，餘為末數。

translations.literal: Subtract from the divisor; the remainder is the terminal number.
translations.idiomatic: For each segment, subtract from the divisor; the remainder is the terminal value.

sentences.zh: 乃四象馴變相加，各其所當之日初末數也。

translations.literal: Then add the four-phase sequential variations—each its corresponding day's initial and terminal numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the four-phase transitions in order, yielding each corresponding day's initial and terminal values.

sentences.zh: 視入轉餘，如初數以下者，加減損益，因循前率；

translations.literal: Inspect the entered rotation remainder: if at or below the initial number, increase or decrease and follow the prior rate;
translations.idiomatic: If the entered rotation remainder falls at or below the initial value, apply increase or decrease following the prior rate;

sentences.zh: 如初數以上，則反其衰，歸於後率云。

translations.literal: if above the initial number, reverse the decline and return to the posterior rate.
translations.idiomatic: if above the initial value, reverse the decline and revert to the posterior rate.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日及餘以入氣、入轉朓朒定數，同名相從，異名相消。

translations.literal: To find the fixed days and remainders for new, crescent, and full moon: with the fixed waxing-waning numbers for entered qi and rotation entry, same name combine, different name cancel.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed days and remainders for each syzygy, apply the fixed waxing-waning numbers for entered qi and rotation entry—same name combine, different name cancel.

sentences.zh: 乃以朓減朒加四象經小餘。

translations.literal: Then waxing subtract and waning add to the four-phase canonical small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract for waxing and add for waning to the four-phase canonical small remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，進大餘。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, carry the large remainder.
translations.idiomatic: When full or insufficient, carry into the large remainder.

sentences.zh: 命以甲子算外，各其定日及小餘。

translations.literal: Assign from jiazi outside the count—each gives its fixed day and small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Assign from jiazi outside the reckoning—each gives its fixed day and small remainder.

sentences.zh: 幹名與後朔葉同者，月大。

translations.literal: When the stem name matches the next new moon's branch, the month is long.
translations.idiomatic: When the stem name matches the next new moon's branch, the month is long.

sentences.zh: 不同者，小；

translations.literal: when they differ, it is short;
translations.idiomatic: When they differ, the month is short;

sentences.zh: 無中氣者，為閏月。

translations.literal: when there is no central qi, it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: when no central qi falls in the month, it is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 凡言夜半者，皆起晨前子正之中。

translations.literal: Whenever speaking of midnight, all begin from the middle of early-morning zi before dawn.
translations.idiomatic: All references to midnight begin from true midnight at the start of zi before dawn.

sentences.zh: 若注曆觀弦望定小餘，不盈晨初餘數者，退一日。

translations.literal: If annotating the calendar, observe the fixed minor remainder at crescent and full moon; if it does not fill the early-morning initial remainder, retreat one day.
translations.idiomatic: In calendar annotation, if the fixed minor remainder at quarter or full moon does not reach the early-morning initial remainder, set the date back one day.

sentences.zh: 其望，小餘雖滿此數，若有交蝕，虧初起在晨初已前者，亦如之。

translations.literal: At full moon, even if the small remainder fills this number, if there is an eclipse and the onset of waning is already before early morning, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies at full moon when the small remainder fills this number but an eclipse begins before early morning.

sentences.zh: 又月行九道遲疾，則三大二小。

translations.literal: Again, the moon's motion in the nine paths has fast and slow phases—hence three long and two short months.
translations.idiomatic: Because the moon's nine-path motion varies in speed, months naturally run three long and two short.

sentences.zh: 以日行盈縮，累增損之，則容有四大三小，理數然也。

translations.literal: Accumulating increase and decrease from the sun's daily surplus and deficit, one may occasionally get four long and three short—the pattern of numbers allows this.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulative adjustment by the sun's daily equation of time can occasionally yield four long and three short months; the arithmetic permits it.

sentences.zh: 若俯循常儀，當察加時早晚，隨其所近而進退之，使不過三小。

translations.literal: If one follows the ordinary rule in practice, one should inspect whether the hour-added time is early or late and advance or retreat accordingly, so as not to exceed three short months.
translations.idiomatic: In practice, inspect whether the hour of occurrence is early or late and adjust accordingly, keeping within three short months.

sentences.zh: 其正月朔，若有交加時正見者，消息前後一兩月，以定大小，令虧在晦二。

translations.literal: If the first-month new moon has an eclipse and the hour-added time is exactly at visibility, shift the long-short determination a month or two before and after, fixing the size so that waning falls on the last or second day.
translations.idiomatic: When the first-month new moon has an eclipse at exact visibility, adjust long-short assignment a month or two on either side so that waning falls on the last or second day.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望夜半日所在度各隨定氣次日以所直日度及餘分命焉。

translations.literal: To derive the solar degree where the sun stands at midnight on fixed new, crescent, and full moon: for each, follow the day after the fixed qi and assign from the reached day's degree and remainder parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar longitude at midnight for each fixed syzygy, follow the day after the fixed solar term and assign from that day's degree and remainder parts.

sentences.zh: 若以五星相加減者，以四約度餘。

translations.literal: If adding or subtracting the five stars, reduce the degree remainder by four.
translations.idiomatic: If adding or subtracting the five planets, divide the degree remainder by four.

sentences.zh: 乃列朔弦望小餘，副之，以乘其日盈縮分，如大衍通法而一，盈加縮減其副，以加其日夜半度餘，命如前，各其日加時日躔所次。

translations.literal: Then array the small remainders of new, crescent, and full moon and keep duplicates; multiply by that day's surplus and deficit fraction; as one per Dayan universal divisor; surplus adds and deficit subtracts from the duplicate; add to that night's midnight degree remainder; assign as before—each gives where the sun's progression stands at the hour of addition.
translations.idiomatic: Array the small remainders for each syzygy and keep duplicate tallies; multiply by that day's equation of time, divide by the Dayan universal divisor, and add or subtract from the duplicate according to surplus or deficit; add to that night's midnight degree remainder and assign as before—each gives where the sun's progression stands at the hour of occurrence.

sentences.zh: 推月九道度凡合朔所交，冬在陰曆，夏在陽曆，月行青道。

translations.literal: To derive the moon's nine-path degrees: at all syzygies at conjunction, when winter is in yin months and summer in yang months, the moon follows the green path.
translations.idiomatic: To derive the moon's nine-path degrees: at syzygy, when winter falls in yin months and summer in yang months, the moon follows the green path.

sentences.zh: 冬、夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，殷黃道東。

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path's half-intersection lies in the spring-equinox lodge, near the ecliptic east.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the green path's half-intersection lies at the spring-equinox lodge, near the ecliptic to the east.

sentences.zh: 立冬、夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，殷黃道東南。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path's half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Spring lodge, near the ecliptic southeast.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path's half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Spring lodge, near the ecliptic to the southeast.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之也。

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 冬在陽曆，夏在陰曆，月行白道。

translations.literal: When winter is in yang months and summer in yin months, the moon follows the white path.
translations.idiomatic: When winter is in yang months and summer in yin months, the moon follows the white path.

sentences.zh: 冬至夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，殷黃道西。

translations.literal: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path's half-intersection lies in the autumn-equinox lodge, near the ecliptic west.
translations.idiomatic: After the Winter and Summer Solstices, the white path's half-intersection lies at the autumn-equinox lodge, near the ecliptic to the west.

sentences.zh: 立北。

translations.literal: After Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path's half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Autumn lodge, near the ecliptic northwest.
translations.idiomatic: After Start-of-Winter and Start-of-Summer, the white path's half-crossing is at the Start-of-Autumn lodge, near the ecliptic northwest.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之也。

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春在陽曆，秋在陰曆，月行硃道。

translations.literal: When spring is in yang months and autumn in yin months, the moon follows the vermilion path.
translations.idiomatic: When spring is in yang months and autumn in yin months, the moon follows the vermilion path.

sentences.zh: 春、秋分後，硃道半交在夏至之宿，殷黃道南。

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermilion path's half-intersection lies in the summer-solstice lodge, near the ecliptic south.
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the vermilion path's half-intersection lies at the summer-solstice lodge, near the ecliptic to the south.

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，硃道半交在立夏之宿，殷黃道西南。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermilion path's half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Summer lodge, near the ecliptic southwest.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermilion path's half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Summer lodge, near the ecliptic to the southwest.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之也。

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 春在陰曆，秋在陽曆，月行黑道。

translations.literal: When spring is in yin months and autumn in yang months, the moon follows the black path.
translations.idiomatic: When spring is in yin months and autumn in yang months, the moon follows the black path.

sentences.zh: 春、秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿，殷黃道北。

translations.literal: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path's half-intersection lies in the winter-solstice lodge, near the ecliptic north.
translations.idiomatic: After the Spring and Autumn Equinoxes, the black path's half-intersection lies at the winter-solstice lodge, near the ecliptic to the north.

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，殷黃道東北。

translations.literal: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path's half-intersection lies in the Start-of-Winter lodge, near the ecliptic northeast.
translations.idiomatic: After Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path's half-intersection lies at the Start-of-Winter lodge, near the ecliptic to the northeast.

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿亦如之也。

translations.literal: At the lodge of opposition, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the opposing lodge, the same applies.

sentences.zh: 四序離為八節，至陰陽之始交，皆以黃道相會，故月有九行。

translations.literal: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; at each yin-yang initial crossing all meet the ecliptic—hence the moon has nine paths of motion.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons yield eight nodes; at each yin-yang crossing the moon meets the ecliptic—hence nine paths of lunar motion.

sentences.zh: 各視月交所入七十二候，距交初黃道日每五度為限。

translations.literal: For each, observe the seventy-two hou entered at the moon's conjunction; from the initial conjunction, ecliptic solar degrees—every five degrees is one band.
translations.idiomatic: For each conjunction entry, take the seventy-two hou from the initial crossing; every five degrees of ecliptic solar longitude is one band.

sentences.zh: 交初交中同。

translations.literal: Initial and middle conjunction are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Initial and middle conjunction follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 亦初數十二，每限減一，數終於四，乃一度強，依平。

translations.literal: Again the initial count is twelve; each band reduced by one until the count ends at four—then one degree slightly strong; follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: Begin at twelve and subtract one per band until four, then one degree slightly strong—use the mean.

sentences.zh: 更從四起，每限增一，終於十二，而至半交，其去黃道六度。

translations.literal: Again begin from four; each band adds one until twelve, reaching half-intersection—six degrees from the ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: Begin again at four; add one per band until twelve at half-intersection, six degrees from the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 又自十二，每限減一，數終於四，亦一度強，依平。

translations.literal: Again from twelve, each band reduced by one until the count ends at four—also one degree slightly strong; follow the mean.
translations.idiomatic: From twelve again, subtract one per band until four, likewise one degree slightly strong—use the mean.

sentences.zh: 更從四起，每限增一，終於十二，復與日軌相會。

translations.literal: Again begin from four; each band adds one until twelve, again meeting the solar track.
translations.idiomatic: Begin at four again; add one per band until twelve, reuniting with the solar track.

sentences.zh: 各累計其數，以乘限度，二百四十而一，得度。

translations.literal: In each case accumulate the counts, multiply by the band number, and as 240 to one obtain degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the counts in order, multiply by the band index, and divide by 240 to obtain degrees.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，二十四除，為分。

translations.literal: What does not fill, divide by twenty-four—as parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder, divided by twenty-four, gives parts.

sentences.zh: 若以二十除之，則大分。

translations.literal: If divided by twenty, then major parts.
translations.idiomatic: If divided by twenty instead, the result is major parts.

sentences.zh: 十二為母，命以半太及強弱也。

translations.literal: Twelve as denominator—assign using half, major, and strong/weak.
translations.idiomatic: With twelve as denominator, assign using half, major, and strong/weak fractions.

sentences.zh: 為月行與黃道差數。

translations.literal: This is the moon's motion and ecliptic difference number.
translations.idiomatic: This is the lunar ecliptic latitude difference.

sentences.zh: 距半交前後各九限，以差數為減；

translations.literal: For nine bands before and after half-intersection, use the difference as decrease;
translations.idiomatic: Within nine bands on either side of half-intersection, subtract the difference;

sentences.zh: 距正交前後各九限，以差數為加。

translations.literal: for nine bands before and after true conjunction, use the difference as increase.
translations.idiomatic: within nine bands on either side of true conjunction, add the difference.

sentences.zh: 此加減是出入六度，單與黃道相交之數也。

translations.literal: This increase and decrease shifts in and out by six degrees—the number of intersection with the ecliptic alone.
translations.idiomatic: This adjustment shifts latitude by six degrees—the value compared directly with the ecliptic alone.

sentences.zh: 若交赤道，則隨氣遷變不恆。

translations.literal: If crossing the equator, it shifts with qi and is not constant.
translations.idiomatic: If measured against the equator, it varies with the seasons and is not constant.

sentences.zh: 計去冬至夏至以來候數，乘黃道所差，十八而一，為月行與赤道差數。

translations.literal: Count the hou elapsed since the Winter or Summer Solstice, multiply the ecliptic difference, and as eighteen to one obtain the moon's motion and equator difference number.
translations.idiomatic: Count hou elapsed since the Winter or Summer Solstice, multiply the ecliptic difference, and divide by eighteen to obtain the lunar equatorial latitude difference.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，赤道外為陽；

translations.literal: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;
translations.idiomatic: For the sun, inside the equator is yin and outside is yang;

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰，黃道外為陽。

translations.literal: for the moon, inside the ecliptic is yin and outside is yang.
translations.idiomatic: for the moon, inside the ecliptic is yin and outside is yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行宿度入春分交後行陰曆，秋分交後行陽曆，皆為同名；

translations.literal: Hence for the moon's lodge motion, after entering the spring-equinox crossing it follows yin months and after the autumn-equinox crossing yang months—both are same name;
translations.idiomatic: Hence after the spring-equinox crossing the moon follows yin months, and after the autumn-equinox crossing yang months—both are same-named;

sentences.zh: 若入春分交後行陽曆，秋分交後行陰曆，皆為異名。

translations.literal: if after the spring-equinox crossing it follows yang months, or after the autumn-equinox crossing yin months, both are different name.
translations.idiomatic: if after the spring-equinox crossing it follows yang months, or after the autumn-equinox crossing yin months, both are differently named.

sentences.zh: 其在同名，以差數為加者加之，減者減之；

translations.literal: Under same name, where the difference is for increase, add it; where for decrease, subtract it;
translations.idiomatic: Under same name, where the difference is for increase, add it; where for decrease, subtract it;

sentences.zh: 若在異名，以差數為加者減之，減者加之。

translations.literal: under different name, where the difference is for increase, subtract it; where for decrease, add it.
translations.idiomatic: under different name, where the difference is for increase, subtract it; where for decrease, add it.

sentences.zh: 皆以增損黃道度為九道定數。

translations.literal: In each case use this to increase or decrease the ecliptic degree, obtaining the nine-path fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these rules to adjust ecliptic longitude and obtain the fixed nine-path number.

sentences.zh: 推月九道平交入氣各以其月恆中氣，去經朔日算及餘秒，加其月經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒，乃以減交終日及餘秒，其餘即各平交入其月恆中氣日算及餘秒也。

translations.literal: To derive the moon's nine-path mean conjunction entry into qi: for each month's constant central qi, remove the mean new moon day count and remainder seconds, add that month's mean new moon hour-added entered conjunction general day and remainder seconds, then subtract from the conjunction terminal days and remainder seconds—the remainder is each mean conjunction's entry into that month's constant central qi day count and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To calculate mean conjunction entry into qi for the moon's nine paths, for each month's constant central solar term subtract the mean new moon day count and second-fractions, add that month's mean new moon hour-added entered-conjunction general day and second-fractions, then subtract from the conjunction terminal days and second-fractions—the remainder is the mean conjunction's entry day count and second-fractions within that month's constant central solar term.

sentences.zh: 滿三元之策及餘秒則去之，其餘即平交入後月恆節氣日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: When full of the three-origin rod count and remainder seconds, cast out; the remainder is the mean conjunction entry into the next month's constant solar term day count and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full three-origin rod counts and second-fractions; the remainder is the mean conjunction's entry day count and second-fractions into the next month's constant solar term.

sentences.zh: 因求次交者，以交終日及餘秒加之。

translations.literal: To seek the next conjunction, add the conjunction terminal days and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next conjunction, add the conjunction terminal days and second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 滿三元之策及餘秒，去之。

translations.literal: When full of the three-origin rod count and remainder seconds, cast out.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out full three-origin rod counts and second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 不滿者，為平交入其氣日算及餘秒。

translations.literal: What does not fill is the mean conjunction entry into that qi day count and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: What does not fill is the mean conjunction's entry day count and second-fractions within that solar term.

sentences.zh: 各以其氣初先後數先加、後減其入餘。

translations.literal: For each, using the prior-and-posterior numbers at the beginning of its qi, first add then subtract to its entry remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For each solar term, apply the lead and lag counts at its beginning—first add, then subtract—to the entry remainder.

sentences.zh: 滿若不足，進退日算，即平交入定氣日算及餘秒也。

translations.literal: When full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day count—that is the mean conjunction entry into fixed solar term day count and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: When the result fills or falls short, advance or retreat the day count—that yields the mean conjunction's entry day count and second-fractions within the fixed solar term.

sentences.zh: 求平交入氣朓朒定數置所入定氣日算，倍六爻乘之，三其小餘，辰法除而從之，以乘其氣損益率，如定氣辰數而一，所得以損益其氣朓朒積為定數也。

translations.literal: To find the fixed waxing-waning number for mean conjunction entry into qi: set the entered fixed solar term day count; double and multiply by six lines; triple the small remainder; divide by the chronogram divisor and carry; multiply by the qi's increase-decrease rate; divide by the fixed solar term's chronogram count to obtain one; use the result to increase or decrease the qi's waxing-waning accumulation—as the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed waxing-waning number for mean conjunction entry into a solar term, set the entered fixed solar term day count; double and multiply by six lines; triple the small remainder and divide by the chronogram divisor with carry; multiply by the solar term's increase-decrease rate and divide by the fixed solar term's chronogram count; use the result to adjust the solar term's waxing-waning accumulation—the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求平交入轉朓朒定數置所入定氣餘，加其日夜半入轉餘，以乘其日損益率，滿大衍通法而一，所得以損益其日朓朒積，乃以交率乘之，交數而一，為定數。
