sentences.zh: 推五星平合置中積分，以天正冬至小餘減之，各以其星終率去之，不盡者，返以減終率，滿大衍通法為日，不滿為餘，即所求年天正冬至夜半後星平合日算及餘秒也。

translations.literal: To derive the five planets' mean conjunctions: set the central accumulated fraction; subtract the celestial first month Winter Solstice small remainder; for each star remove by its terminal rate; what does not exhaust, in turn subtract from the terminal rate; what fills the Dayan universal divisor counts as days, what does not fill is the remainder—that gives the mean conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions after midnight at the celestial first month Winter Solstice for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: To calculate the five planets' mean conjunctions, set the central accumulated fraction and subtract the celestial first month's Winter Solstice small remainder; for each planet remove by its terminal rate, and what does not exhaust in turn subtract from the terminal rate; each full Dayan universal divisor counts as one day and the remainder is the residue—the mean conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions after midnight at the celestial first month's Winter Solstice for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求平合入爻象曆置積年，各以其星變以差乘之，滿乾實去之，不滿者，以大衍通法約之，為日。

translations.literal: To find mean conjunction entry into the line-and-image calendar: set the accumulated years; for each multiply its star's variation-by-difference; cast out what fills Qian actuality; what does not fill, reduce by the Dayan universal divisor—as days.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean conjunction entry into the line-and-image calendar, set the accumulated years; for each planet multiply its variation-by-difference; cast out full Qian actuality cycles; what does not fill, reduce by the Dayan universal divisor—the days.

sentences.zh: 不盡為餘秒。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is remainder second-fractions.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is the remainder second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 以減其星冬至夜半後平合日算及餘秒，即平合入曆算數及餘秒也。

translations.literal: Subtract from that star's mean conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions after midnight at the Winter Solstice—the mean conjunction entry calendar rod count and remainder second-fractions.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from that planet's mean conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions after midnight at the Winter Solstice—the mean conjunction entry calendar rod count and remainder second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 各四約其餘，同其辰法也。

translations.literal: For each, reduce the remainder by four to match the double-hour divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For each, quarter the remainder to align with the double-hour divisor.

sentences.zh: 求平合入四象置曆算數及秒，以一象之算及餘秒除之，所得，依入爻象次命起少陽算外，即平合所入象算數及餘秒也。

translations.literal: To find mean conjunction entry into the four images: set the calendar rod count and second-fractions; divide by one image's rod count and remainder second-fractions; assign from Lesser Yang outside the reckoning in line-and-image sequence—the mean conjunction's entered image rod count and remainder second-fractions.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean conjunction entry into the four images, set the calendar rod count and second-fractions and divide by one image's rod count and remainder second-fractions; assign from Lesser Yang outside the reckoning in line-and-image sequence—the mean conjunction's entered image rod count and remainder second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 求平合入六爻置所入象算數及餘秒，以一爻之算及餘秒除之，所得，命起其象初爻算外，即平合所入爻算數及餘秒也。

translations.literal: To find mean conjunction entry into the six lines: set the entered image rod count and remainder second-fractions; divide by one line's rod count and remainder second-fractions; assign from that image's first line outside the reckoning—the mean conjunction's entered line rod count and remainder second-fractions.
translations.idiomatic: To find mean conjunction entry into the six lines, set the entered image rod count and remainder second-fractions and divide by one line's rod count and remainder second-fractions; assign from that image's first line outside the reckoning—the mean conjunction's entered line rod count and remainder second-fractions.

sentences.zh: 求四象六爻每算損益及進退定數以所入爻與後爻損益率相減為前差，又以後爻與次後爻損益率相減為後差，前後差相減為中差。

translations.literal: To find the four images' six lines' per-rod increase-decrease and advance-retreat fixed numbers: subtract the entered line's increase-decrease rate from the next line's rate—as the forward difference; again subtract the next line's rate from the one after—as the backward difference; subtract the forward and backward differences—as the middle difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the four images' six lines' per-rod increase-decrease and advance-retreat fixed numbers, subtract the entered line's increase-decrease rate from the next line's rate—the forward difference; subtract the next line's rate from the one after—the backward difference; subtract the two differences—the middle difference.

sentences.zh: 置所入爻並後爻損益率，半中差以加之，九之，二百七十四而一，為爻末率，因為後爻初率。

translations.literal: Set the entered line and the next line's increase-decrease rates; add half the middle difference; multiply by nine and divide by 274—as the line terminal rate, which becomes the next line's initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered line and the next line's increase-decrease rates, add half the middle difference, multiply by nine and divide by 274—the line terminal rate, which becomes the next line's initial rate.

sentences.zh: 皆因前爻末率，以為後爻初率。

translations.literal: Each takes the prior line's terminal rate as the next line's initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: Each line takes the prior line's terminal rate as the next line's initial rate.

sentences.zh: 初末之率相減，為爻差。

translations.literal: Subtract the initial and terminal rates—the line difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the initial and terminal rates—the line difference.

sentences.zh: 倍爻差，九之，二百七十四而一為算差。

translations.literal: Double the line difference; multiply by nine and divide by 274—as the rod difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the line difference, multiply by nine and divide by 274—the rod difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，加減初末，各為定率。

translations.literal: Halve it; add and subtract from the initial and terminal rates—each is a fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it and use the result to adjust the initial and terminal rates—each is a fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 以算差累加減爻初定率，少象以差減，老象以差加。

translations.literal: Accumulate the rod difference to add and subtract from each line's initial fixed rate—the young image subtracts the difference, the old image adds the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the rod difference to adjust each line's initial fixed rate—the young image subtracts the difference and the old image adds it.

sentences.zh: 為每損益率。

translations.literal: These are the per-step increase-decrease rates.
translations.idiomatic: These are the per-step increase-decrease rates.

sentences.zh: 循累其率，隨所入爻，損益其下進退，即各得其算定。

translations.literal: Follow and accumulate these rates; according to the entered line, increase or decrease the advance and retreat below—each rod count is thereby fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Apply these rates in sequence; according to the entered line, adjust the advance and retreat below—each rod count is thereby fixed.

sentences.zh: 其四象初爻無初率，上爻無末率，皆置本爻損益，四而九之，二百七十四而一，各以初末率減之，皆互得其率。

translations.literal: For the four images, the first line has no initial rate and the top line no terminal rate; in each case set this line's increase-decrease rate, multiply by four and nine and divide by 274; subtract the result from each initial and terminal rate—in each case obtaining the other's rate.
translations.idiomatic: For the four images, the first line has no initial rate and the top line no terminal rate; in each case set that line's increase-decrease rate, multiply by four and nine and divide by 274, and subtract the result from each initial and terminal rate—in each case obtaining the other's rate.

sentences.zh: 餘依術算，各得所求。

translations.literal: The remainder follows the procedure—each gives what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder follows the procedure—each yields what is sought.

sentences.zh: 求平合入進退定數各置其星平合所入爻之算差，半之，以減其所入算損益率。

translations.literal: To find the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number: for each set its star's mean conjunction entered line rod difference; halve it; subtract from that entered rod's increase-decrease rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number, for each planet set its mean conjunction entered line rod difference, halve it, and subtract from that entered rod's increase-decrease rate.

sentences.zh: 損者，以所入餘乘限差，辰法除，並差而半之；

translations.literal: For decrease: multiply the entered remainder by the limit difference; divide by the double-hour divisor; combine with the difference and halve;
translations.idiomatic: For a decrease rate, multiply the entered remainder by the limit difference, divide by the double-hour divisor, combine with the difference and halve;

sentences.zh: 益者，半入餘乘差，亦辰法除。

translations.literal: For increase: multiply half the entered remainder by the difference; again divide by the double-hour divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For an increase rate, multiply half the entered remainder by the difference and again divide by the double-hour divisor.

sentences.zh: 加所減之率，乃以入餘乘之，辰法而一，所得以損益其算下進退，各為平合所入進退定數。

translations.literal: Add to the rate subtracted; then multiply by the entered remainder and divide by the double-hour divisor; use the result to increase or decrease the advance and retreat below—each is the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the reduced rate, multiply by the entered remainder and divide by the double-hour divisor, and use the result to adjust the advance and retreat below—each is the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number.

sentences.zh: 此法微密，用算稍繁。

translations.literal: This method is subtle and precise; the reckoning is somewhat elaborate.
translations.idiomatic: This method is subtle and precise, though the reckoning is somewhat elaborate.

sentences.zh: 若從省求之，亦可置其所入算餘，以乘其下損益率，如辰法而一，所得以損益其算下進退，各為定數。

translations.literal: If one seeks it by the abbreviated method, one may also set the entered rod remainder, multiply by the increase-decrease rate below it, divide by the double-hour divisor to obtain one, and use the result to increase or decrease the advance and retreat below the rod—each is a fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: If one seeks it by the abbreviated method, one may instead set the entered rod remainder, multiply by the increase-decrease rate below it, and divide by the double-hour divisor; use the result to adjust the advance and retreat below the rod—each yields a fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求常合置平合所入進退定數，金星則倍置之。

translations.literal: To find the regular conjunction: set the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number; for Venus, double it.
translations.idiomatic: To find the regular conjunction, set the mean conjunction's entered advance-retreat fixed number; for Venus, double it.

sentences.zh: 各以合下乘數乘之，除數除之，所得滿辰法為日，不滿為餘，以進加退減平合日算及餘秒，先以四約平合餘，然以進加退減也。

translations.literal: For each multiply by the conjunction-below multiplier and divide by the removal divisor; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as days, what does not fill is the remainder; use advance to add and retreat to subtract from the mean conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions—first quarter the mean conjunction remainder, then add for advance and subtract for retreat.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet multiply by the conjunction-below multiplier and divide by the removal divisor; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as one day and the remainder is the residue; add for advance and subtract for retreat from the mean conjunction day count and second-fractions—first quarter the mean conjunction remainder, then apply advance and retreat.

sentences.zh: 即為冬至夜半後常合日算及餘也。

translations.literal: That is the regular conjunction day count and remainder after midnight at the Winter Solstice.
translations.idiomatic: That gives the regular conjunction day count and remainder after midnight at the Winter Solstice.

sentences.zh: 求定合置常合日先後定數，四而一，所得滿辰法為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To find the fixed conjunction: set the regular conjunction day's fixed number of advance and retard; divide by four; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as days, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed conjunction, set the regular conjunction day's fixed advance-and-retard number and divide by four; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as one day and what does not fill is the remainder.

sentences.zh: 乃以先減後加常合算及餘，即為冬至夜半後定合日算及餘也。

translations.literal: Then first subtract and then add to the regular conjunction count and remainder—that is the fixed conjunction day count and remainder after midnight at the Winter Solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Then first subtract and then add to the regular conjunction count and remainder—that gives the fixed conjunction day count and remainder after midnight at the Winter Solstice.

sentences.zh: 求定合度置其日盈縮分，四而一以定合餘乘之，滿辰法而一，所得以盈加縮減其定餘，以加其日夜半日度餘，先四約夜半日度餘以加之。

translations.literal: To find the fixed conjunction degree: set that day's surplus and deficit fraction; divide by four and multiply by the fixed conjunction remainder; when it fills the double-hour divisor obtain one; use surplus to add and deficit to subtract from its fixed remainder; add to that night's midnight solar degree remainder—first quarter the midnight solar degree remainder before adding.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed conjunction degree, set that day's equation-of-time fraction, divide by four and multiply by the fixed conjunction remainder, and divide by the double-hour divisor; add for surplus and subtract for deficit from the fixed remainder; add to that night's midnight solar degree remainder—first quarter the midnight solar degree remainder before adding.

sentences.zh: 滿辰法從度。

translations.literal: When it fills the double-hour divisor, carry to degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When it fills the double-hour divisor, carry into degrees.

sentences.zh: 依前命之算外，即為定合加時度及餘也。

translations.literal: Assign outside the reckoning as before—that is the fixed conjunction hour-of-addition degree and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Assign outside the reckoning as before—that gives the fixed conjunction hour-of-occurrence degree and remainder.

sentences.zh: 求定合月日置冬至夜半後定合日算及餘秒，以天正冬至大小餘加之，天正經朔大小餘減之。

translations.literal: To find the fixed conjunction month and day: set the fixed conjunction day count and remainder second-fractions after midnight at the Winter Solstice; add the celestial first month Winter Solstice large and small remainders; subtract the celestial first month canonical new moon large and small remainders.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed conjunction month and day, set the fixed conjunction day count and second-fractions after midnight at the Winter Solstice; add the celestial first month's Winter Solstice large and small remainders and subtract the celestial first month's canonical new moon large and small remainders.

sentences.zh: 其至、朔小餘，皆以四約之，然用加減。

translations.literal: The solstice and new-moon small remainders are each quartered; then add and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter the solstice and new-moon small remainders, then use them to add and subtract.

sentences.zh: 若至大餘少於經朔大餘者，又以爻數加之，然以經朔大小餘減之。

translations.literal: If the solstice large remainder is less than the canonical new moon large remainder, again add the line count; then subtract the canonical new moon large and small remainders.
translations.idiomatic: If the solstice large remainder is less than the canonical new moon large remainder, add the line count and then subtract the canonical new moon large and small remainders.

sentences.zh: 其餘滿四象之策及餘，除之，為月數，不盡者，為入朔日算及餘。

translations.literal: Divide its remainder by the four-images rod count and remainder; that makes the month count; what is not exhausted is the new-moon entry day count and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by the four-images rod count and remainder to obtain the month count; what is not exhausted is the new-moon entry day count and remainder.

sentences.zh: 命月數起天正日算起經朔算外，即定所在日月也。

translations.literal: Assign the month count from the celestial first month day count outside the canonical new moon count—that is the fixed month and day where it stands.
translations.idiomatic: Count the months from the celestial first month day count outside the canonical new moon reckoning—that gives the fixed month and day.

sentences.zh: 其定朔大餘有進退，進減退加一日，為在其日月定及餘也。

translations.literal: If its fixed new moon large remainder has advance or retreat, subtract one day for advance and add one day for retreat—that is the fixed month and day where it stands, with remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new moon large remainder requires advance or retreat, subtract one day for advance and add one day for retreat—that gives the fixed month and day with its remainder.

sentences.zh: 求定合入爻置常合及定合應加減定數，同名相從，異名相消。

translations.literal: To find fixed conjunction entry into the line: set the fixed numbers to be added and subtracted for the regular and fixed conjunctions; same name combine, different name cancel.
translations.idiomatic: To find fixed conjunction entry into the line, set the fixed numbers to be added and subtracted for the regular and fixed conjunctions—same-named quantities combine, differently named quantities cancel.

sentences.zh: 乃以加減其平合入爻算餘，滿若不足，進退其算，即為定合入爻算數及餘也。

translations.literal: Then add and subtract to the mean conjunction entered line rod remainder; when full or insufficient, advance or retreat the rod count—that is the fixed conjunction entered line rod count and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Then add and subtract from the mean conjunction's entered line rod remainder; when it fills or falls short, advance or retreat the rod count—that gives the fixed conjunction entered line rod count and remainder.

sentences.zh: 求變行初日入爻置定合入爻算數及餘，以合後伏下變行度常率加之，滿爻率去之，命爻次如前，即次變初日入爻算數及餘也。

translations.literal: To find variation-motion first-day entry into the line: set the fixed conjunction entered line rod count and remainder; add the conjunction-after hiding-below variation-motion degree mean rate; cast out what fills the line rate; assign line sequence as before—that is the next variation's first-day entered line rod count and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first day of a variation motion's line entry, set the fixed conjunction's entered line rod count and remainder and add the post-conjunction pre-visibility variation-motion degree mean rate; cast out full line rates and assign the line sequence as before—the next variation's first-day entered line rod count and remainder.

sentences.zh: 更求次變入爻變入，但以其下行度常加之，去命如上節。

translations.literal: To find further the next variation's line entry: simply add its next-station degree mean rate; cast out and assign as in the prior section.
translations.idiomatic: To find each subsequent variation's line entry, simply add that station's degree mean rate; cast out and assign as in the prior section.

sentences.zh: 求變行初日入進退定數各置其變行初日入爻算數及餘，如平合求進退術入之，即得變行初日所入進退定數也。

translations.literal: To find the variation-motion first day's entered advance-retreat fixed number: for each set its variation-motion first day entered line rod count and remainder; enter by the mean conjunction advance-retreat method as before—that gives the variation-motion first day's entered advance-retreat fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first-day advance-retreat fixed number for each variation motion, set that variation's first-day entered line rod count and remainder and apply the mean conjunction advance-retreat method—thus obtaining the first-day entered advance-retreat fixed number.

sentences.zh: 置進退定數，各以其下乘數乘之，除數除之，所得各為進退變率。

translations.literal: Set the advance-retreat fixed numbers; for each multiply by its below multiplier and divide by the removal divisor; what is obtained is each the advance-retreat variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the advance-retreat fixed numbers; for each multiply by its below-multiplier and divide by the removal divisor—each result is an advance-retreat variation rate.

sentences.zh: 求變行日度率置其本進退變率與後變率，同名者，相消為差。

translations.literal: To find variation-motion day-and-degree rates: set its native advance-retreat variation rate and the next variation rate; when same-named, cancel each other—the difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find variation-motion day-and-degree rates, set the native advance-retreat variation rate and the next variation rate; when they share the same name, cancel them to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 在進前少，在退前多，各以差為加；

translations.literal: When in advance the prior is less, when in retreat the prior is more—in each case add the difference;
translations.idiomatic: When in advance the prior rate is less, when in retreat the prior rate is more—in each case add the difference;

sentences.zh: 在進前多，在退前少，各以差為減。

translations.literal: When in advance the prior is more, when in retreat the prior is less—in each case subtract the difference.
translations.idiomatic: When in advance the prior rate is more, when in retreat the prior rate is less—in each case subtract the difference.

sentences.zh: 異名者，相從謂並。

translations.literal: When differently named, combine—called the sum.
translations.idiomatic: When differently named, combine them—this is called the sum.

sentences.zh: 前退後進，各以並為加；

translations.literal: Prior retreat and subsequent advance—in each case add the sum;
translations.idiomatic: Prior retreat and subsequent advance—in each case add the sum;

sentences.zh: 前進後退，各以並為減。

translations.literal: Prior advance and subsequent retreat—in each case subtract the sum.
translations.idiomatic: Prior advance and subsequent retreat—in each case subtract the sum.

sentences.zh: 逆行度率則反之。

translations.literal: For retrograde degree rates, reverse it.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde degree rates, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 皆以差及並，加減日度中率，各為日度變率。

translations.literal: In all cases add and subtract the difference and sum from the day-and-degree mean rate—each is a day-and-degree variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: In all cases add and subtract the difference and sum from the day-and-degree mean rate—each yields a day-and-degree variation rate.

sentences.zh: 其水星疾行，直以差以並加減度之中率，為變率。

translations.literal: For Mercury's swift motion, directly add and subtract the difference and sum from the degree mean rate—as the variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury's swift motion, directly add and subtract the difference and sum from the degree mean rate to obtain the variation rate.

sentences.zh: 其日直因中率為變率，不煩加減也。

translations.literal: Its days directly take the mean rate as the variation rate, without need for addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Its days directly take the mean rate as the variation rate, without further addition or subtraction.

sentences.zh: 求變行日度定率以定合日與後變初日先後定數，同名相消為差，異名者相從為並。

translations.literal: To find variation-motion day-and-degree fixed rates: take the fixed conjunction day's and the next variation first day's fixed numbers of advance and retard; same name cancel—as difference; different name combine—as sum.
translations.idiomatic: To find variation-motion day-and-degree fixed rates, take the fixed conjunction day's and the next variation first day's fixed advance-and-retard numbers; same-named quantities cancel to form the difference, differently named quantities combine to form the sum.

sentences.zh: 四而一，所得滿辰法為度。

translations.literal: Divide by four; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by four; what fills the double-hour divisor counts as degrees.

sentences.zh: 乃以盈加縮減其合後伏度之變率及合前伏日之變率。

translations.literal: Then add for surplus and subtract for deficit from the conjunction-after hiding-degree variation rate and the conjunction-before hiding-day variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: Then add for surplus and subtract for deficit from the post-conjunction pre-visibility degree variation rate and the pre-conjunction pre-visibility day variation rate.

sentences.zh: 金水夕合日度，加減反之。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury at evening conjunction in day-degree terms, reverse the addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury at evening conjunction, reverse the additions and subtractions in day-degree terms.

sentences.zh: 其二留日之變率，若差於中率者，即以所差之數為度，各加減本遲度之變率。

translations.literal: If the variation rate of its two stationary days differs from the mean rate, take the amount of difference as degrees and in each case add and subtract from the native slow-degree variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the variation rate of its two stationary days differs from the mean rate, take the amount of difference as degrees and add or subtract it from the native slow-degree variation rate.

sentences.zh: 謂以多於中率之數加之，少於中率之數減之。

translations.literal: That is, add when the amount exceeds the mean rate; subtract when it falls short of the mean rate.
translations.idiomatic: That is, add when the amount exceeds the mean rate and subtract when it falls short.

sentences.zh: 以下加減准此。

translations.literal: For the additions and subtractions below, follow this rule.
translations.idiomatic: For the additions and subtractions below, follow this rule.

sentences.zh: 退行度變率，若差於中率者，即倍所差之數，各加減本疾度之變率。

translations.literal: If the retrograde-degree variation rate differs from the mean rate, double the amount of difference and in each case add and subtract from the native swift-degree variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the retrograde-degree variation rate differs from the mean rate, double the amount of difference and add or subtract it from the native swift-degree variation rate.

sentences.zh: 其木土二星，既無遲疾，即加減前後順行度之變率。

translations.literal: Jupiter and Saturn, having no slow and swift phases, simply add and subtract from the before-and-after direct-motion degree variation rates.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter and Saturn, having no slow and swift phases, simply adjust the before-and-after direct-motion degree variation rates.

sentences.zh: 其水星疾行度之變率，若差於中率者，即以所差之數為日，各加減留日變率。

translations.literal: If Mercury's swift-motion degree variation rate differs from the mean rate, take the amount of difference as days and in each case add and subtract from the stationary-day variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury's swift-motion degree variation rate differs from the mean rate, take the amount of difference as days and add or subtract it from the stationary-day variation rate.

sentences.zh: 其留日變率若少不足減者，即侵減遲日變率也。

translations.literal: If the stationary-day variation rate is too small to subtract from, encroach and subtract from the slow-day variation rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the stationary-day variation rate is too small to subtract from, borrow from and subtract the slow-day variation rate.

sentences.zh: 各加減變率訖，皆為日度定率。

translations.literal: When the variation rates have each been added and subtracted, all are day-and-degree fixed rates.
translations.idiomatic: When all variation rates have been adjusted, each becomes a day-and-degree fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 其日定率有分者，前後輩之。

translations.literal: When day fixed rates have fractional parts, match them before and after.
translations.idiomatic: When day fixed rates have fractional parts, allocate them between the prior and subsequent rates.

sentences.zh: 輩，配也。

translations.literal: "Match" means allocate.
translations.idiomatic: "Match" means allocate.

sentences.zh: 以少分配多分，滿全為日，有餘轉配。

translations.literal: Allocate the smaller fraction to the larger; when full, that makes whole days; if there is remainder, turn and allocate.
translations.idiomatic: Allocate the smaller fraction to the larger; when it fills a whole unit that makes whole days; if any remainder remains, carry it forward and allocate again.

sentences.zh: 其諸變率不加減者，皆依變率為定率。

translations.literal: Variation rates that are not added to or subtracted from all follow the variation rate as the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Variation rates that receive no adjustment all follow the variation rate as the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 求定合後夜半星所在度置其星定合餘，以減辰法，餘以其星初日行分乘之，辰法而一，以加定合加時度餘，滿辰法為度。

translations.literal: To find the star's degree after midnight following fixed conjunction: set that star's fixed conjunction remainder; subtract from the double-hour divisor; multiply the remainder by that star's first-day motion parts; divide by the double-hour divisor; add to the fixed conjunction hour-of-addition degree remainder; when full of the double-hour divisor, that makes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the planet's degree after midnight following fixed conjunction, set that planet's fixed conjunction remainder and subtract it from the double-hour divisor; multiply the remainder by that planet's first-day motion parts and divide by the double-hour divisor; add to the fixed conjunction hour-of-occurrence degree remainder; when the result fills the double-hour divisor, that makes degrees.

sentences.zh: 依前命之算外，即定合後夜半星所在宿及餘。

translations.literal: Assign outside the reckoning as before—that is the lodge and remainder where the star stands after midnight following fixed conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Assign outside the reckoning as before—that gives the lodge and remainder where the planet stands after midnight following fixed conjunction.

sentences.zh: 自此以後，各依其星，計日行度所至，皆從夜半為始也。

translations.literal: From here onward, for each according to its star, reckoning where the daily degree motion reaches—all begin from midnight.
translations.idiomatic: From here onward, for each planet reckon where the daily degree motion reaches—all reckoning begins from midnight.

sentences.zh: 轉求次日夜半星行至：各以其星一日所行度分，順加退減之。

translations.literal: To find in turn the star's position at the next night's midnight: for each add in direct motion and subtract in retrograde motion according to that star's one-day degree motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find in turn the planet's position at the next night's midnight, for each planet add in direct motion and subtract in retrograde motion according to its one-day degree motion.

sentences.zh: 其行有小分者，各滿其法從行分一。

translations.literal: When the motion has small parts, in each case when they fill its divisor carry one to motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: When the motion has small parts, carry one into motion parts whenever they fill their divisor.

sentences.zh: 行分滿辰法，從度一。

translations.literal: When motion parts fill the double-hour divisor, carry one to degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When motion parts fill the double-hour divisor, carry one into degrees.

sentences.zh: 合之前後，伏不注度，留者因前，退則依減。

translations.literal: Before and after conjunction, do not register degrees during invisibility; at station continue from the prior position; in retrograde subtract accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after conjunction, do not register degrees during invisibility; at station continue from the prior position; in retrograde subtract accordingly.

sentences.zh: 順行出虛，去六虛之差；

translations.literal: In direct motion exiting the void, remove the six-void difference;
translations.idiomatic: In direct motion exiting the void, remove the six-void difference;

sentences.zh: 退行入虛，先加此差。

translations.literal: In retrograde motion entering the void, first add this difference.
translations.idiomatic: In retrograde motion entering the void, first add this difference.

sentences.zh: 先置六虛之差，四而一，然用加減。

translations.literal: First set the six-void difference and divide by four; then add and subtract.
translations.idiomatic: First set the six-void difference and divide by four; then apply the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 訖，皆以轉法約行分為度分，各得每日所至。

translations.literal: When done, in all cases reduce motion parts to degree parts by the rotation divisor—each yields the daily position reached.
translations.idiomatic: When done, in all cases reduce motion parts to degree parts by the rotation divisor—each yields the daily position reached.

sentences.zh: 其三星之行日度定率，或加或減，益疾益遲，每日漸差，難為預定，今且略據日度中率商量置之。

translations.literal: The three stars' day-and-degree fixed rates may be added to or subtracted from, increasing swiftness and slowness with daily gradual difference—hard to predetermine; for now we provisionally set them by consulting the day-and-degree mean rate.
translations.idiomatic: The three planets' day-and-degree fixed rates may be increased or decreased, growing swifter or slower with daily gradual difference—hard to predetermine; for now we provisionally set them by consulting the day-and-degree mean rate.

sentences.zh: 其定率既有盈縮，即差數合隨而增損，當先檢括諸變定率與中率相近者，因用其差，求其初末之日行分為主。

translations.literal: Since the fixed rates already have surplus and deficit, the difference numbers for conjunction follow with increase and decrease; one should first examine the various variation fixed rates nearest the mean rate, use their difference accordingly, and take the first and last days' daily motion parts as primary.
translations.idiomatic: Since the fixed rates already carry surplus and deficit, the conjunction difference numbers follow with increase and decrease; one should first examine the variation fixed rates nearest the mean rate, use their difference accordingly, and take the first and last days' daily motion parts as the basis.

sentences.zh: 自餘變因此消息，加減其差，各求初末行分。

translations.literal: From the remaining variations derive increase and decrease from this; add and subtract their difference; in each case find the first and last motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: From the remaining variations derive increase and decrease from this basis; add and subtract their difference to find the first and last motion parts for each.

sentences.zh: 迴圈比校，使際會參合，衰殺相循。

translations.literal: Compare in cycles round and round so that junctures meet and combine and waxing and waning follow in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Compare in cycles round and round so that junctures meet and combine and waxing and waning follow in sequence.

sentences.zh: 其金水皆以平行為主，前後諸變，亦准此求之。

translations.literal: Venus and Mercury both take uniform motion as primary; the variations before and after likewise follow this method to find them.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mercury both take uniform motion as primary; the variations before and after likewise follow this method.

sentences.zh: 其合前伏雖有日度定率，如至合而與後算計卻不葉者，皆從後算為定。

translations.literal: Although the pre-conjunction hiding period has day-and-degree fixed rates, if upon reaching conjunction the forward reckoning from the posterior count does not fit, all take the posterior reckoning as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Although the pre-conjunction invisibility period has day-and-degree fixed rates, if upon reaching conjunction the forward reckoning from the posterior count does not fit, all take the posterior reckoning as fixed.

sentences.zh: 其五星初見伏之度，去日不等，各以日度與星度相校。

translations.literal: The five planets' first appearance and invisibility degrees stand at unequal distance from the sun; in each case compare solar degree with stellar degree.
translations.idiomatic: The five planets' first appearance and invisibility stand at unequal angular distance from the sun; in each case compare the sun's degree with the planet's degree.

sentences.zh: 木去日十四度，金十一度，火土水各十七度，皆見；

translations.literal: Jupiter fourteen degrees from the sun, Venus eleven degrees, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury each seventeen degrees—all are visible;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter fourteen degrees from the sun, Venus eleven degrees, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury each seventeen degrees—all are visible;

sentences.zh: 各減一度皆伏。

translations.literal: Reduce each by one degree—all are hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce each by one degree—all are hidden.

sentences.zh: 其木火土三星前順之初，後順之末，又金水疾行、留、退初末，皆是見伏之初日，注曆消息定之。

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the start of the first direct segment and the end of the last direct segment; and for Venus and Mercury, the start and end of swift motion, station, and retrograde—all are the first days of appearance and invisibility; register them fixed by the calendar's waxing and waning reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, the start of the first direct segment and the end of the last direct segment; and for Venus and Mercury, the start and end of swift motion, station, and retrograde—all mark the first days of appearance and invisibility; register them fixed by the calendar's waxing-and-waning reckoning.

sentences.zh: 其金水及日月等度，並棄其分也。

translations.literal: For Venus, Mercury, and the sun and moon's equal degrees, discard the parts altogether.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus, Mercury, and the sun and moon at equal degrees, discard the fractional parts altogether.

sentences.zh: 求每日差置所差分為實，以所差日為法。

translations.literal: To find the daily difference: set the amount differed as dividend and the days differed as divisor.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily difference, set the amount differed as dividend and the days differed as divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，所得為行分，不盡者為小分。

translations.literal: Divide dividend by divisor to obtain one; what is obtained is motion parts, what is not exhausted is small parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor; the quotient is motion parts and the remainder is small parts.

sentences.zh: 即是也每日差所行分及小分也。

translations.literal: That is precisely the daily difference in motion parts and small parts.
translations.idiomatic: These are precisely the daily difference in motion parts and small parts.

sentences.zh: 其差若全，不用此術。

translations.literal: If the difference is whole, do not use this method.
translations.idiomatic: If the difference is a whole number, do not use this method.

sentences.zh: 求平行度及分置度定率，以辰法乘之，有分者從之，如日定率而一，為平行分。

translations.literal: To find uniform-motion degrees and parts: set the degree fixed rate; multiply by the double-hour divisor, with fractional parts carried along; divide by the day fixed rate—that gives uniform-motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find uniform-motion degrees and parts, set the degree fixed rate, multiply by the double-hour divisor with fractional parts carried along, and divide by the day fixed rate—the result is uniform-motion parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡，為小分。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is small parts.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is small parts.

sentences.zh: 其行分滿辰法為度，即是一日所行度及分。

translations.literal: When motion parts fill the double-hour divisor that makes degrees—that is the one-day motion in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When motion parts fill the double-hour divisor that makes degrees—this is the one-day motion in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求差行初末日行度及分置日定率減一，以差分乘之。

translations.literal: To find differential-motion first and last day motion degrees and parts: set the day fixed rate minus one; multiply by the difference parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find differential-motion first and last day motion degrees and parts, set the day fixed rate minus one and multiply by the difference parts.

sentences.zh: 二而一，為差率，以加減平行分。

translations.literal: Halve it—that is the difference rate; add and subtract from uniform-motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it to obtain the difference rate, then add and subtract from uniform-motion parts.

sentences.zh: 益疾者，以差率減平為初日，加平為末日。

translations.literal: When increasing swiftness, subtract the difference rate from uniform motion for the first day and add uniform motion for the last day.
translations.idiomatic: When increasing swiftness, subtract the difference rate from uniform motion for the first day and add uniform motion for the last day.

sentences.zh: 益遲者，以差率加平為初日，減平為末日也。

translations.literal: When increasing slowness, add the difference rate to uniform motion for the first day and subtract uniform motion for the last day.
translations.idiomatic: When increasing slowness, add the difference rate to uniform motion for the first day and subtract uniform motion for the last day.

sentences.zh: 加減訖，即是初末日所行度及分。

translations.literal: When addition and subtraction are done, that is the first and last days' motion degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When the additions and subtractions are done, that gives the first and last days' motion degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 其差不全而與日相合者，先置日定率減一，以所差分乘之，為實。

translations.literal: When the difference is not whole but agrees with the days, first set the day fixed rate minus one; multiply by the difference parts—as dividend.
translations.idiomatic: When the difference is not whole but agrees with the day count, first set the day fixed rate minus one and multiply by the difference parts—the product is the dividend.

sentences.zh: 倍所差日為法。

translations.literal: Double the days differed—as divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Double the days differed—the result is the divisor.

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，為行分。

translations.literal: Divide dividend by divisor to obtain one—that gives motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor—the quotient is motion parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，因為小分，然為差率。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted becomes small parts and then the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted becomes small parts and then serves as the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 求差行次日行度及分置初日行分，益遲者，以每日差減之；

translations.literal: To find differential-motion next-day motion degrees and parts: set the first-day motion parts; when increasing slowness, subtract the daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find differential-motion next-day motion degrees and parts, set the first-day motion parts; when increasing slowness, subtract the daily difference;

sentences.zh: 益疾者，以每日差加之，即為次日行度及分也。

translations.literal: When increasing swiftness, add the daily difference—that is the next day's motion degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: When increasing swiftness, add the daily difference—that gives the next day's motion degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 其每日差、初日行皆有小分，母既不同，當令同之。

translations.literal: The daily difference and first-day motion each have small parts; since the denominators differ, make them the same.
translations.idiomatic: The daily difference and first-day motion each have small parts; since the denominators differ, make them the same.

sentences.zh: 然用加減，轉求次日，准此各得所求也。

translations.literal: Then add and subtract; find the next day in turn; follow this rule to obtain each result sought.
translations.idiomatic: Then add and subtract and find each next day in turn; follow this rule to obtain each result sought.

sentences.zh: 徑求差行餘日行度及分置所求日減一，以每日差乘之，以加減初日行分，益遲減之，益疾加之。

translations.literal: To find directly differential-motion remaining days' motion degrees and parts: set the day sought minus one; multiply by the daily difference; add and subtract from the first-day motion parts—subtract for increasing slowness, add for increasing swiftness.
translations.idiomatic: To find directly the motion degrees and parts for the remaining days of differential motion, set the day sought minus one, multiply by the daily difference, and add or subtract from the first-day motion parts—subtract for increasing slowness, add for increasing swiftness.

sentences.zh: 滿辰法為度，不滿為行分，即是所求日行度及分也。

translations.literal: When full of the double-hour divisor that makes degrees, when not full that is motion parts—that is the daily motion degrees and parts sought.
translations.idiomatic: When the result fills the double-hour divisor that makes degrees; when it does not fill, the remainder is motion parts—this is the daily motion degrees and parts sought.

sentences.zh: 求差行，先定日數，徑求積度及分置所求日減一，次每日差乘之，二而一，所得，以加減初日行分。

translations.literal: To find differential motion when the day count is fixed first, and to find directly accumulated degrees and parts: set the day sought minus one; next multiply by the daily difference and halve; use the result to add and subtract from the first-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find differential motion when the day count is fixed first and to find directly the accumulated degrees and parts, set the day sought minus one, multiply by the daily difference and halve, and use the result to add or subtract from the first-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 益遲減之，益疾加之。

translations.literal: Subtract for increasing slowness; add for increasing swiftness.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for increasing slowness; add for increasing swiftness.

sentences.zh: 以所求日乘之，如辰法而一，為積度。

translations.literal: Multiply by the day sought and divide by the double-hour divisor—that gives accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the day sought and divide by the double-hour divisor—that gives accumulated degrees.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，為行分。

translations.literal: What is not exhausted is motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: What is not exhausted is motion parts.

sentences.zh: 即是從初日至所求日積度及分也。

translations.literal: That is the accumulated degrees and parts from the first day to the day sought.
translations.idiomatic: That is the accumulated degrees and parts from the first day to the day sought.

sentences.zh: 求差行，先定度數，徑求日數置所求行度，以辰法乘之，有分者從之。

translations.literal: To find differential motion when the degree count is fixed first, and to find directly the day count: set the degree motion sought; multiply by the double-hour divisor, with fractional parts carried along.
translations.idiomatic: To find differential motion when the degree count is fixed first and to find directly the day count, set the degree motion sought and multiply by the double-hour divisor, with fractional parts carried along.

sentences.zh: 八之，如每日差而一，為積。

translations.literal: Multiply by eight; divide by the daily difference—that gives the accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by eight and divide by the daily difference—that gives the accumulation.

sentences.zh: 倍初日行分，以每日差加減之。

translations.literal: Double the first-day motion parts; add and subtract the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the first-day motion parts and add or subtract the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 益遲者加之，益疾者減之。

translations.literal: Add for increasing slowness; subtract for increasing swiftness.
translations.idiomatic: Add for increasing slowness; subtract for increasing swiftness.

sentences.zh: 如每日差而一，為率。

translations.literal: Divide by the daily difference to obtain one—as the rate.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the daily difference to obtain one—the result is the rate.

sentences.zh: 今自乘，以積加減之，益遲者以積減之，益疾者以積加之。

translations.literal: Now multiply by itself; add or subtract the accumulation—when increasing slowness subtract the accumulation; when increasing speed add the accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Now square it; add or subtract the accumulation—when motion grows slower subtract the accumulation; when motion grows faster add the accumulation.

sentences.zh: 開方除之。

translations.literal: Extract the square root and divide.
translations.idiomatic: Extract the square root and divide.

sentences.zh: 所得，以率加減之。

translations.literal: What is obtained: add or subtract the rate.
translations.idiomatic: Take the result and add or subtract the rate.

sentences.zh: 益遲者以率加之，益疾者以率減之。

translations.literal: When increasing slowness add the rate; when increasing speed subtract the rate.
translations.idiomatic: When motion grows slower add the rate; when motion grows faster subtract the rate.

sentences.zh: 乃半之，即所求日數也。

translations.literal: Then halve it—that is the number of days sought.
translations.idiomatic: Then halve it—that gives the number of days sought.

sentences.zh: 其開方除者，置所開之數為實，借一算於實之下，名曰下法。

translations.literal: For extracting the square root and dividing: set the number to be rooted as the dividend; borrow one count below the dividend—this is called the lower divisor.
translations.idiomatic: For extracting the square root and dividing, set the number to be rooted as the dividend; place one count below the dividend—this is called the lower divisor.

sentences.zh: 步之，超一位，置商于上方，副商於下法之上，名曰方法。

translations.literal: Step through it; skip one place; set the quotient above; place a secondary quotient on the lower divisor—this is called the square divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Step through it; skip one place; set the quotient above; place a secondary quotient on the lower divisor—this is called the square divisor.

sentences.zh: 命上商以除實，畢，倍方法一折，下法再折，乃置後商於下法之上，名曰隅法。

translations.literal: Assign the upper quotient to divide the dividend; when finished, double the square divisor and fold once, fold the lower divisor twice; then set the next quotient on the lower divisor—this is called the corner divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Use the upper quotient to divide the dividend; when finished, double the square divisor and fold once, fold the lower divisor twice; then set the next quotient on the lower divisor—this is called the corner divisor.

sentences.zh: 副隅並方，命後商以除實，畢，隅從方法折下就除，如前開之。

translations.literal: Combine the secondary corner with the square divisor; assign the next quotient to divide the dividend; when finished, the corner follows the square divisor, folds down, and divides as before—extract the root as before.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the secondary corner with the square divisor; use the next quotient to divide the dividend; when finished, the corner follows the square divisor, folds down, and divides as before—continue extracting the root in the same way.

sentences.zh: 訖除，依上術求之即得也。

translations.literal: When division is finished, seek by the procedure above and obtain.
translations.idiomatic: When division is finished, apply the procedure above and the result is obtained.

sentences.zh: 求星行黃道南北各視其星變行入陰陽爻而定之。

translations.literal: To find whether a star's motion lies north or south of the yellow path: for each, observe which yin or yang line its variation motion enters and fix it thereby.
translations.idiomatic: To find whether a star's motion lies north or south of the ecliptic, observe which yin or yang line its variation motion enters and determine it accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其前變入陽爻為黃道北，入陰爻為黃道南；

translations.literal: In the preceding variation, entering a yang line is north of the yellow path; entering a yin line is south of the yellow path;
translations.idiomatic: In the preceding variation, entering a yang line means north of the ecliptic; entering a yin line means south of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 後變入陽爻為黃道南，入陰爻為黃道北。

translations.literal: in the following variation, entering a yang line is south of the yellow path; entering a yin line is north of the yellow path.
translations.idiomatic: in the following variation, entering a yang line means south of the ecliptic; entering a yin line means north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 其金水二星，以爻變為前變，各計其變行，起初日入爻之算，盡老象上爻末算之數，不滿變行度常率者，因置其數，以變行日定率乘之，如變行度常率而一，為日。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, take the line variation as the preceding variation; for each compute its variation motion from the day count entered at the first day of line entry through the last count of the old image's upper line; when it does not fill the variation motion's degree constant rate, set the number, multiply by the variation motion's daily fixed rate, divide by the variation motion's degree constant rate to obtain one—as days.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, take the line variation as the preceding variation; for each compute its variation motion from the day count entered at the first day of line entry through the last count of the old image's upper line; when it does not fill the variation motion's degree constant rate, set the number, multiply by the variation motion's daily fixed rate, and divide by the variation motion's degree constant rate to obtain days.

sentences.zh: 其入變日數，與此日數以下者，星在黃道南北，依本所入陰陽爻為定。

translations.literal: When the days entered in variation and this day count are below the threshold, the star's position north or south of the yellow path is fixed according to the yin or yang line originally entered.
translations.idiomatic: When the days entered in variation fall at or below this day count, the star's position north or south of the ecliptic is fixed according to the yin or yang line originally entered.

sentences.zh: 過此日數之外者，黃道南北則返之。

translations.literal: Beyond this day count, north and south of the yellow path are reversed.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond this day count, north and south of the ecliptic are reversed.
